verses.en: The words of Yirmeyahu the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.am: በብንያም አገር በዓናቶት ከነበሩ ካህናት የሆነ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ የኤርምያስ ቃል።

verses.en: To whom the word of YAHUAH came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Yehudah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሞጽ ልጅ በኢዮስያስ ዘመን በመንግሥቱ በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መጣለት።

verses.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yehudah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Yehudah, unto the carrying away of Yerushalayim captive in the fifth month.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም ዘመን፥ እስከ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ እስከ ኢዮስያስ ልጅ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ፍጻሜ፥ ኢየሩሳሌም እስከ ተማረከችበት እስከ አምስተኛው ወር ድረስ መጣ።

verses.en: Then the word of YAHUAH came unto me, saying,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.am: በሆድ ሳልሠራህ አውቄሃለሁ፥ ከማኅፀንም ሳትወጣ ቀድሼሃለሁ፥ ለአሕዛብም ነቢይ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: Then said I, Ah, YAHUAH! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
verses.am: እኔም። ወዮ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ እነሆ፥ ብላቴና ነኝና እናገር ዘንድ አላውቅም አልሁ።

verses.en: But YAHUAH said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንዲህ አለኝ። ወደምሰድድህ ሁሉ ዘንድ ትሄዳለህና፥ የማዝዝህንም ሁሉ ትናገራለህና። ብላቴና ነኝ አትበል።

verses.en: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኔ አድንህ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና ከፊታቸው አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Then YAHUAH put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And YAHUAH said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እጁን ዘርግቶ አፌን ዳሰሰ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። እነሆ፥ ቃሌን በአፍህ ውስጥ አኑሬአለሁ፤

verses.en: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.am: እነሆ። ትነቅልና ታፈርስ ዘንድ፥ ታጠፋና ትገለብጥ ዘንድ፥ ትሠራና ትተክል ዘንድ በአሕዛብና በመንግሥታት ላይ ዛሬ አድርጌሃለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of YAHUAH came unto me, saying, Yirmeyahu, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.am: ደግሞ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ኤርምያስ ሆይ፥ ምን ታያለህ? እያለ ወደ እኔ መጣ። እኔም። የለውዝ በትር አያለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: Then said YAHUAH unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። እፈጽመው ዘንድ በቃሌ እተጋለሁና መልካም አይተሃል አለኝ።

verses.en: And the word of YAHUAH came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
verses.am: ሁለተኛም ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ምን ታያለህ? እያለ ወደ እኔ መጣ። እኔም። የሚፈላ አፍላል አያለሁ፥ ፊቱም ከሰሜን ወገን ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: Then YAHUAH said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ከሰሜን ወገን ክፉ ነገር በምድሪቱ በተቀመጡ ሁሉ ላይ ይገለጣል።

verses.en: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith YAHUAH; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Yerushalayim, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Yehudah.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ በሰሜን ያሉትን የመንግሥታትን ወገኖች ሁሉ እጠራለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እነርሱም ይመጣሉ እያንዳንዳቸውም በኢየሩሳሌም በር መግቢያ በዙሪያዋ በቅጥርዋ ሁሉ ላይ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ዙፋናቸውን ያስቀምጣሉ።

verses.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other elohim, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
verses.am: ስለ ክፋታቸውም ሁሉ፥ እኔን ስለ ተው ለሌሎችም አማልክት ስላጠኑ ለእጃቸውም ሥራ ስለ ሰገዱ፥ ፍርዴን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ወገብህን ታጠቅ፥ ተነሥም፥ ያዘዝሁህም ሁሉ ንገራቸው፤ በፊታቸው እንዳላስፈራህ አትፍራቸው።

verses.en: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Yehudah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ላይ በይሁዳም ነገሥታት በአለቆችዋና በካህናትዋ ላይ በምድሪቱም ሕዝብ ላይ እንደ ተመሸገ ከተማ እንደ ብረትም ዓምድ እንደ ናስም ቅጥር ዛሬ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith YAHUAH, to deliver thee.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር ይዋጋሉ፥ ነገር ግን አድንህ ዘንድ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና ድል አይነሡህም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Moreover the word of YAHUAH came to me, saying,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Go and cry in the ears of Yerushalayim, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ጆሮ ጩኽ፥ እንዲህም በል። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የብላቴንነትሽን ምሕረት የታጨሽበትንም ፍቅር፥ በምድረ በዳ ዘር ባልተዘራበት ምድር እንደ ተከተልሽኝ አስቤአለሁ።

verses.en: Yisra'el was holiness unto YAHUAH, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እስራኤል ለእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነበረ፥ የቡቃያውም በkWraት ነበረ፤ የበሉት እንደ በደለኞች ይቈጠራሉ፥ ክፉም ነገር ያገኛቸዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Hear ye the word of YAHUAH, O house of Ya'aqob, and all the families of the house of Yisra'el:
verses.am: የያዕቆብ ቤት የእስራኤልም ቤት ወገኖች ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አባቶቻችሁ ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቁ፥ ከንቱነትንም የተከተሉ፥ ከንቱም የሆኑ ምን ክፋት አግኝተውብኝ ነው?

verses.en: Neither said they, Where is YAHUAH that brought us up out of the land of Mitsrayim, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
verses.am: እነርሱም። ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣን፥ በምድረ በዳም በባድማ gWdጓድም ባለበት ምድር፥ በውኃ ጥምና በሞት ጥላ ምድር፥ ማንም በማያልፍበትና ማንም በማይቀመጥበት ምድር የመራን እግዚአብሔር ወዴት አለ? አላሉም።

verses.en: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
verses.am: ፍሬዋንና በረከትዋንም ትበሉ ዘንድ ወደ ፍሬያማ ምድር አገባኋችሁ፤ ነገር ግን በገባችሁ ጊዜ ምድሬን አረከሳችሁ፥ ርስቴንም አጐሳቈላችሁ።

verses.en: The priests said not, Where is YAHUAH? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
verses.am: ካህናቱም። እግዚአብሔር ወዴት አለ? አላሉም፥ ባለ ኦሪቶችም አላወቁኝም፤ ገዢዎችም ዐመፁብኝ፥ ነቢያትም በበኣል ትንቢት ተናገሩ፥ የማይረባንም ነገር ተከተሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith YAHUAH, and with your children's children will I plead.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር እከራከራለሁ፥ ከልጆቻችሁም ልጆች ጋር እከራከራለሁ።

verses.en: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
verses.am: ወደ ኪቲም ደሴቶች እለፉና ተመልከቱ፥ ወደ ቄዳርም ላኩና እጅግ መርምሩ፥ እንደዚህም ያለ ነገር ህኖ እንደ ሆነ እዩ።

verses.en: Hath a nation changed their elohim, which are yet no elohim? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
verses.am: በውኑ አማልክት ያልሆኑትን አማልክቱን የለወጣቸው አንድ ሕዝብ አለን? ነገር ግን ሕዝቤ ክብሩን ለማይረባ ነገር ለወጠ።

verses.en: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሰማያት ሆይ፥ በዚህ ተደነቁ፥ እጅግም ደንግጡና ተንጥቀጡ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሁለቱን ክፉ ነገሮች አድርገዋልና፤ እኔን የሕያውን ውኃ ምንጭ ትተውኛል፥ የተቀደዱትንም gWdጓዶች፥ ውኃውን ይይዙ ዘንድ የማይችሉትን gWdጓዶች፥ ለራሳቸው ቆፍረዋል።

verses.en: Is Yisra'el a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
verses.am: በውኑ እስራኤል ባሪያ ነውን? ወይስ የቤት ውላጅ ነውን? ስለምን ብዝበዛ ሆነ?

verses.en: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
verses.am: የአንበሳ ደቦሎች በእርሱ ላይ አገሡ፥ ድምፃቸውንም ሰጡ፤ ምድሩንም ባድማ አደረጉ፥ ከተሞቹም ተቃጠሉ የሚቀመጥባቸውም የለም።

verses.en: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
verses.am: የሜምፎስና የጣፍናስ ልጆች አስነወሩሽ አላገጡብሽም።

verses.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, when he led thee by the way?
verses.am: ይህ ሁሉ የሆነብሽ እኔን ስለ ተውሽ አይደለምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር አምላክሽ።

verses.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Mitsrayim, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
verses.am: አሁንስ የሺሖርን ውኃ ትጠጪ ዘንድ በግብጽ መንገድ ምን ጉዳይ አለሽ? የኤፍራጥስንም ውኃ ትጠጪ ዘንድ በአሦር መንገድ ምን ጉዳይ አለሽ?

verses.en: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, and that my fear is not in thee, saith YAHUAH of hosts.
verses.am: ክፋትሽ ይገሥጽሻል ክዳትሽም ይዘልፍሻል፤ አምላክሽንም እግዚአብሔርን የተውሽ እኔንም መፍራት የሌለብሽ ክፉና መራራ ነገር እንደ ሆነ እወቂ፥ ተመልከቺ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.
verses.am: ከጥንት ጀምሮ ቀንበርሽን ሰብሬአለሁ እስራትሽንም ቈርጫለሁ፤ አንቺም። አላገለግልም አልሽ፥ ነገር ግን ከፍ ባለው ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ከለምለምም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ለማመንዘር ተጋደምሽ።

verses.en: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
verses.am: እኔ የተመረጠች ወይን ፍጹምም እውነተኛ ዘር አድርጌ ተክዬሽ ነበር፤ አንቺ ግን ክፉ የእንግዳ ወይን ግንድ ሆነሽ እንዴት ተለወጥሽብኝ?

verses.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእንዶድ ብትታጠቢም፥ ለራስሽም ሳሙና ብታበዢ፥ በእኔ ፊት በኃጢአትሽ ረክሰሻል ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
verses.am: አንቺስ። አልረከስሁም በአሊምንም አልተከተልሁም እንዴት ትያለሽ? በቈላ ያለውን መንገድሽን ተመልከቺ፥ ያደረግሽውንም እወቂ፤ በመንገድም ላይ እንደ ተለቀቀች እንደ ፈጣን ግመል ሆነሻል፤

verses.en: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
verses.am: በምኞትዋ ነፋስን እንደምታሸትት፥ በምድረ በዳ እንደ ለመደች እንደ ሜዳ አህያ ነሽ፤ ከምኞትዋ የሚመልሳት ማን ነው? የሚሹአት ሁሉ አይደክሙም፥ በወራትዋ ያገኙአታል።

verses.en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
verses.am: እግርሽን ከሸካራ መንገድ gWroሮሽንም ከውኃ ጥም ከልክዪ፤ አንቺ ግን። እጨክናለሁ፥ እንግዶችን ወድጄአለሁና፥ እከተላቸዋለሁም አልሽ።

verses.en: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Yisra'el ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
verses.am: ሌባ በተያዘ ጊዜ እንደሚያፍር እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ቤት፥ እነርሱና ንጉሦቻቸውም አለቆቻቸውም ካህናቶቻቸውም ነቢያቶቻቸውም ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
verses.am: ግንዱን።አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤ ድንጋዮንም። አንተ ወለድኸኝ ይላሉ፤ ፊታቸውንም ሳይሆን ጀርባቸውን ሰጡኝ፥ በመከራቸው ጊዜ ግን። ተነሥተህ አድነን ይላሉ።

verses.en: But where are thy elohim that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy elohim, O Yehudah.
verses.am: ለአንተ የሠራሃቸው አማልክትህ ወዴት ናቸው? ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ አማልክትህ እንደ ከተሞችህ KWTር እንዲሁ ናቸውና ይነሡ በመከራህም ጊዜ ያድኑህ።

verses.en: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር የምትከራከሩ ለምንድር ነው? ሁላችሁ ዐምፃችሁብኛል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
verses.am: ልጆቻችሁን በከንቱ ቀሥፌአቸዋለሁ፤ ተግሣጽን አልተቀበሉም፤ ሰይፋችሁ እንደሚሰብር አንበሳ ነቢያቶቻችሁን በልቶአል።

verses.en: O generation, see ye the word of YAHUAH. Have I been a wilderness unto Yisra'el? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?
verses.am: ትውልድ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ተመልከቱ። በውኑ ለእስራኤል ምድረ በዳ ወይስ የጨለመች ምድር ሆንሁባትን? ሕዝቤስ ስለ ምን። እኛ ፈርጥጠናል፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ወደ አንተ አንመለስም ይላል?

verses.en: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
verses.am: በውኑ ቆንጆ ጌጥዋን ወይስ ሙሽራ ዝርግፍ ጌጥዋን ትረሳለችን? ሕዝቤ ግን የማይቈጠር ወራት ረስቶኛል።

verses.en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
verses.am: ፍቅርን ለመሻት መንገድሽን እንዴት ታቀኛለሽ! ስለዚህ ለክፉዎች ሴቶች እንኳ መንገድሽን አስተምረሻል።

verses.en: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
verses.am: በእጆችሽም የንጹሐን ድሆች ደም ተገኝቶአል፤ በእነዚህ ሁሉ ላይ በግልጥ አገኘሁት እንጂ በስውር ፈልጌ አላገኘሁትም።

verses.en: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
verses.am: አንቺ ግን። ንጹሕ ነኝ፤ በእውነት KWTaው ከእኔ ተመልሶአል አልሽ። እነሆ። ኃጢአት አልሠራሁም ብለሻልና በፍርድ እከስስሻለሁ።

verses.en: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Mitsrayim, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
verses.am: መንገድሽን ትለውጪ ዘንድ ለምን እጅግ ትሮጫለሽ? አሦር እንዳሳፈረሽ ግብጽ ያሳፍርሻል።

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for YAHUAH hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሄር የታመንሽባቸውን ጥሎአልና፥ በእነርሱም አይከናወንልሽምና እጅሽን በራስሽ ላይ አድርገሽ ከዚያ ደግሞ ትወጫለሽ። a

verses.en: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በሰው ዘንድ። ሰው ሚስቱን ቢፈታ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ ሄዳ ሌላ ወንድ ብታገባ፥ በውኑ ደግሞ ወደ እርሱ ትመለሳለችን? ያች ሴት እጅግ የረከሰች አይደለችምን? ይባላል። አንቺ ከብዙ ውሽሞች ጋር አመንዝረሻል፥ ወደ እኔም ትመለሻለሽን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.
verses.am: ዓይንሽን አንሥተሽ ወደ ወናዎች ኮረብቶች ተመልከቺ፤ ያልተጋደምሽበት ስፍራ ወዴት አለ? ዓረባዊ በምድረ በዳ እንደሚቀመጥ አንቺ በመንገድ ላይ ተቀምጠሽ ትጠብቂያቸው ነበር፤ በግልሙትናሽና በኃጢአትሽ ምድሪቱን አረከስሽ።

verses.en: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ካፊያ ተከለከለ፥ የኋለኛውም ዝናብ ጠፋ፤ የጋለሞታም ሴት ፊት ነበረብሽ፥ ታፍሪም ዘንድ እንቢ ብለሻል።

verses.en: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
verses.am: አሁንም። አንተ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የብላቴንነቴ ወዳጅ ነህ ብለሽ አልጮኽሽልኝምን? ለዘላለም ይቈጣልን?

verses.en: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
verses.am: እስከ ፍጻሜስ ድረስ ይጠብቀዋልን? እነሆ፥ እንዲህ ብለሽ ተናገርሽ፥ እንደ ተቻለሽም መጠን ክፉን ነገር አደረግሽ።

verses.en: YAHUAH said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Yisra'el hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በንጉሡ በኢዮስያስ ዘመን እንዲህ አለኝ። ከዳተኛይቱ እስራኤል ያደረገችውን አየህን? ወደ ረዘመው ተራራ ሁሉ ከለመለመ ዛፍም ሁሉ በታች ሄደች በዚያም ጋለሞተች።

verses.en: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Yehudah saw it.
verses.am: ይህንም ሁሉ ካደረገች በኋላ። ወደ እኔ ትመለሳለች ብዬ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን አልተመለሰችም፤ አታላይ እኅትዋም ይሁዳ አየች።

verses.en: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Yisra'el committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Yehudah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
verses.am: ከዳተኛይቱም እስራኤል ስላመነዘረች ስለዚህ ፈትቻታለሁ የፍችዋንም ወረቀት ሰጥቻታለሁ፤ አታላይ እኅትዋ ይሁዳ ግን እንዳልፈራች እርስዋም ደግሞ ሄዳ እንደ ጋለሞተች አየሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
verses.am: በግልሙትናዋም በመቅለልዋም ምድሪቱ ረከሰች፤ እርስዋም ከድንጋይና ከግንድ ጋር አመነዘረች።

verses.en: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Yehudah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዚህም ሁሉ አታላይቱ ይሁዳ በሐሰት እንጂ በፍጹም ልብዋ ወደ እኔ አልተመለሰችም።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto me, The backsliding Yisra'el hath justified herself more than treacherous Yehudah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ከአታላይቱ ከይሁዳ ይልቅ ከዳተኛይቱ እስራኤል ጸደቀች።

verses.en: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Yisra'el, saith YAHUAH; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith YAHUAH, and I will not keep anger for ever.
verses.am: ሂድና ይህን ቃል ወደ ሰሜን ተናገር፥ እንዲህም በል። ከዳተናይቱ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ተመለሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ መሐሪ ነኝና፥ ለዘላለምም አልቈጣምና በእናንተ ላይ ፊቴን አላደርግም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በአምላክሽ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ እንዳመፅሽ፥ መንገድሽንም ከለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ለእንግዶች እንደ ዘረጋሽ፥ ቃሌንም እንዳልሰማሽ ኃጢአትሽን ብቻ እወቂ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Turn, O backsliding children, saith YAHUAH; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
verses.am: ከዳተኞች ልጆች ሆይ፥ እኔ ባላችሁ ነኝና ተመለሱ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንዱንም ከአንዲት ከተማ ሁለቱንም ከአንድ ወገን እወስዳችኋለሁ፥ ወደ ጽዮንም አመጣችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.am: እንደ ልቤም በግ ጠባቆችን እሰጣችኋለሁ፥ በእውቀትና በማስተዋልም ይጠብቁአችኋል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith YAHUAH, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of YAHUAH: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
verses.am: በበዛችሁም ጊዜ በምድርም ላይ በረባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያ ዘመን። የእግዚአብሔር የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት ብለው ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይጠሩም፤ ልብ አያደርጉትም፥ አያስቡትምም፥ አይሹትምም፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም አይደረግም።

verses.en: At that time they shall call Yerushalayim the throne of YAHUAH; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of YAHUAH, to Yerushalayim: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ኢየሩሳሌምን የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ብለው ይጠሩአታል፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ወደ እርስዋ ይሰበሰባሉ፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ክፉውን እልከኛ ልባቸውን ተከትለው አይሄዱም።

verses.en: In those days the house of Yehudah shall walk with the house of Yisra'el, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን የይሁዳ ቤት ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ይሄዳል፤ በአንድም ሆነው ከሰሜን ምድር ርስት አድርጌ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
verses.am: እኔ ግን። ከወንዶች ልጆች ጋር እንዴት አደርግሻለሁ? ያማረችውንስ ምድር የከበረችውን የአሕዛብን ሠራዊት ርስት እንዴት እሰጥሻለሁ? ብዬ ነበር። ደግሞ። አባቴ ብለሽ ትጠሪኛለሽ እኔንም ከመከተል አትመለሽም ብዬ ነበር።

verses.en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Yisra'el, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ሚስት ባልዋን እንደምታታታልል እንዲሁ አታለላችሁኝ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Yisra'el: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten YAHUAH their YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች መንገዳቸውን አጣምመዋልና፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ረስተዋልና በወናዎች ኮረብቶች ላይ የልመናቸውና ልቅሶአቸው ድምፅ ተሰማ።

verses.en: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከዳተኞች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ተመለሱ፥ ከዳተኛነታችሁንም እፈውሳለሁ። እነሆ፥ አንተ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ነህና ወደ አንተ እንመጣለን።

verses.en: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in YAHUAH our YAHUAH is the salvation of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በእውነት የኮረብቶችና የተራሮች ፍጅት ከንቱ ናት፤ በእውነት የእስራኤል መዳን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከትንሽነታችን ጀምሮ የአባቶቻችን ድካም፥ በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም፥ እፍረት በልቶባቸዋል።

verses.en: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against YAHUAH our YAHUAH, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከትንሽነታችን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ እኛና አባቶቻችን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርተናልና፥ የአምላካችንንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማንምና በእፍረታችን እንጋደም፥ ውርደታችንም ይክደነን።

verses.en: If thou wilt return, O Yisra'el, saith YAHUAH, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ብትመለስ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመለስ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ርkWsvትህንም ከፊቴ ብታስወግድ፥ ባትናወጥም፥

verses.en: And thou shalt swear, YAHUAH liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
verses.am: ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብለህም በእውነትና በቅንነት በጽድቅም ብትምል፥ አሕዛብ በእርሱ ይባረካሉ በእርሱም ይመካሉ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH to the men of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለይሁዳና ለኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላልና። ጥጋቱን እርሻ እረሱ በእሾህም ላይ አትዝሩ።

verses.en: Circumcise yourselves to YAHUAH, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Yehudah and inhabitants of Yerushalayim: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.am: እናንተም የይሁዳ ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ስለ ሥራችሁ ክፋት KWTaዬ እንደ እሳት እንዳይወጣ የሚያጠፋውም ሳይኖር እንዳያቃጥል፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገረዙ፥ የልባችሁንም ሸለፈት አስወግዱ።

verses.en: Declare ye in Yehudah, and publish in Yerushalayim; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ዘንድ ተናገሩ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ አውሩና። በአገሪቱ ላይ መለከት ንፉ በሉ፤ ጮኻችሁም። ሁላችሁ ተሰብሰቡ ወደ ተመሸጉትም ከተሞች እንግባ በሉ።

verses.en: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.am: ከሰሜን ክፉ ነገርንና ጽኑ ጥፋትን አመጣለሁና ወደ ጽዮን ዓላማን አንሡ፤ ሽሹ፥ አትዘግዩ።

verses.en: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the nations is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
verses.am: አንበሳ ከጭፍቅ ዱር ወጥቶአል፥ አሕዛብንም የሚዘርፍ ተነሥቶአል፤ ምድርሽን ባድማ ያደርግ ዘንድ ከስፍራው ወጥቶአል፥ ከተሞችሽም ሰው የሌለባቸው ፍርስራሾች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of YAHUAH is not turned back from us.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ KWTa ከእኛ ዘንድ አልተመለሰምና ማቅ ልበሱ፥ አልቅሱም ዋይም በሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith YAHUAH, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የንጉሡና የመኳንንቱ ልብ ይጠፋል፥ ካህናቱም ይደነቃሉ ነቢያቱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: Then said I, Ah, YAHUAH! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Yerushalayim, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ወዮ፥ አንተ ሰይፍ እስከ ነፍስ ድረስ በደረሰ ጊዜ። ሰላም ይሆንላችኋል ብለህ ይህን ሕዝብና ኢየሩሳሌምን እጅግ አታለልህ አልሁ።

verses.en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Yerushalayim, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜ ለዚህ ሕዝብና ለኢየሩሳሌም። ለማበጠር ወይም ለማጥራት ሳይሆን የሚያቃጥል ነፋስ በምድረ በዳ ካሉ ከወናዎች ኮረብቶች ወደ ወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ይመጣል፤

verses.en: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
verses.am: ስለ እኔ ጽኑ የሆነ ነፋስ ከእነዚህ ይመጣል ይባላል። አሁንም እኔ ደግሞ ፍርዴን በእነርሱ ላይ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እንደ ደመና ይወጣል፥ ሰረገሎቹም እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ፤ ፈረሶቹም ከንስር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ናቸው። ጠፍተናልና ወዮልን።

verses.en: O Yerushalayim, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ትድኚ ዘንድ ልብሽን ከክፉ ነገር እጠቢ። ክፉ አሳብ የሚኖርብሽ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው?

verses.en: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
verses.am: የተናጋሪ ድምፅ ከዳን ዘንድ ይናገራልና፥ ከኤፍሬምም ኮረብቶች መከራን ያወራልና።

verses.en: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Yerushalayim, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Yehudah.
verses.am: ለአሕዛብ አሰሙና። እነሆ፥ ጠባቂዎች ከሩቅ አገር ይመጣሉ፤ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ላይ ይጮኻሉ ብላችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አውሩ።

verses.en: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ ዓመፀኛ ሆናለችና በዙሪያዋ ከብበው እንደ እርሻ ጠባቂዎች ሆነውባታል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
verses.am: መንገድሽና ሥራሽ ይህን አድርጎብሻል፤ ይህ ክፋትሽ መራር ነው፥ ወደ ልብሽም ደርሶአል።

verses.en: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
verses.am: አንጀቴ! አንጀቴ! ልቤ በጣም ታምሞአል፥ በውስጤም ልቤ ታውኮብኛል፤ ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ የመለከትን ድምፅና የሰልፍን ውካታ ሰምተሻልና ዝም እል ዘንድ አልችልም።

verses.en: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
verses.am: መከራ በመከራ ላይ ተጠርቶአል፤ ምድርም ሁሉ ተበዝብዛለችና፤ በድንገትም ድንኳኔ በቅጽበት ዓይንም መጋረጃዎቼ ጠፉ።

verses.en: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.am: ዓላማውን የምመለከት፥ የመለከቱንስ ድምፅ የምሰማ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.en: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሰንፈዋልና አላወቁኝም፤ ሰነፎች ልጆች ናቸው፥ ማስተዋልም የላቸውም፤ ክፉ ነገርን ለማድረግ ብልሃተኞች ናቸው፥ በጎ ነገርን ማድረግ ግን አያውቁም።

verses.en: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ባዶ ነበረች አንዳችም አልነበረባትም፤ ሰማያትንም አየሁ፥ ብርሃንም አልነበረባቸውም።

verses.en: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
verses.am: ተራሮችን አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ተንቀጠቀጡ፥ ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ተናወጡ።

verses.en: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.am: አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ሰው አልነበረም፥ የሰማይም ወፎች ሁሉ ሸሽተው ነበር።

verses.en: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of YAHUAH, and by his fierce anger.
verses.am: አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ፍሬያማ እርሻ ምድረ በዳ ሆነች፥ ከተሞችም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ከጽኑ KWTaው የተነሣ ፈርሰው ነበር።

verses.en: For thus hath YAHUAH said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላል። ምድር ሁሉ ባድማ ትሆናለች፥ ነገር ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋትም።

verses.en: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምድር ታለቅሳለች፥ በላይም ሰማይ ይጠKWraል፤ ተናግሬአለሁና፥ አስቤአለሁም፤ አልጸጸትም ከእርሱም አልመለስም።

verses.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
verses.am: ከፈረሰኞችና ከቀስተኞች ድምፅ የተነሣ ከተማ ሁሉ ሸሽታለች፤ ወደ ችፍግ ዱርም ይገባሉ በቋጥኝ ላይም ይወጣሉ፤ ከተማ ሁሉ ተለቅቃለች የሚቀመጥባትም ሰው የለም።

verses.en: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
verses.am: አንቺም የተበዘበዝሽ ሆይ፥ ምን ታደርጊአለሽ? ቀይ በለበስሽ ጊዜ፥ በወርቅ አንባርም ባጌጥሽ ጊዜ፥ ዓይንሽንም በkWl በተኳልሽ ጊዜ፥ በከንቱ ታጌጫለሽ፤ ውሽሞችሽ አቃለሉሽ፥ ነፍስሽን ይሹአታል።

verses.en: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.am: እንደምታምጥ የበkWrዋንም እንደምትወልድ ሴት ድምፅ ሰምቻለሁና፤ የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ድምፅ በድካም ይሰልላል፥ እጆችዋንም ትዘረጋለችና። ተገድለው ከሞቱት የተነሣ ነፍሴ ዝላለችና ወዮልኝ! አለች።

verses.en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Yerushalayim, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም መንገድ እየተመላለሳችሁ ሩጡ፥ ተመልከቱም፥ እወቁም፥ በአደባባይዋም ፈልጉ፤ ፍርድን የሚያደርገውን እውነትንም የሚሻውን ሰው ታገኙ እንደሆነ ይቅር እላታለሁ።

verses.en: And though they say, YAHUAH liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ቢሉ የሚምሉት በሐሰት ነው።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ዓይንህ እውነትን የምትመለከት አይደለችምን? አንተ ቀሥፈሃቸዋል ነገር ግን አላዘኑም፥ ቀጥቅጠሃቸውማል ነገር ግን ተግሣጽን እንቢ አሉ፤ ፊታቸውን ከድንጋይ ይልቅ አጠንክረዋል፤ ይመለሱ ዘንድ እንቢ አሉ።

verses.en: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of YAHUAH, nor the judgment of their YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኔም። የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድና የአምላካቸውን ሕግ አላወቁምና እነዚህ በእውነት ድሆችና ሰነፎች ናቸው፤

verses.en: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of YAHUAH, and the judgment of their YAHUAH: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.am: ወደ ታላላቆቹ እሄዳለሁ እናገራቸውማለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገንድና የአምላካቸውን ሕግ ያውቃሉና አልሁ። እነዚህ ግን ቀንበሩን በአንድነት ሰብረዋል፥ እስራቱንም ቈርጠዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኃጢአታቸው በዝቶአልና፥ የክዳታቸውም ብዛት ጸንቶአልና ስለዚህ አንበሳ ከዱር ወጥቶ ይሰብራቸዋል፥ የበረሀም ተkWla ያጠፋቸዋል፥ ነብርም በከተሞቻቸው ላይ ይተጋል፥ ከዚያም የሚወጣ ሁሉ ይነጠቃል።

verses.en: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no elohim: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
verses.am: በእነዚህ ነገሮች ይቅር የምልሽ እንዴት አድርጌ ነው? ልጆችሽ ትተውኛል አማልክትም ባልሆኑ ምለዋል፤ ካጠገብኋቸውም በኋላ አመነዘሩ በጋለሞቶቹም ቤት ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
verses.am: እንደ ተቀለቡ ፈረሶች ሆኑ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም ከባልንጀሮቻቸው ሚስቶች ኋላ አሽካኩ።

verses.en: Shall I not visit for these things? saith YAHUAH: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.en: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not YAHUAH's.
verses.am: ወደ ቅጥርዋ ወጥታችሁ አፍርሱ፥ ነገር ግን ፈጽማችሁ አታጥፉ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር አይደሉምና ቅርንጫፍዋን ውሰዱ።

verses.en: For the house of Yisra'el and the house of Yehudah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤትና የይሁዳ ቤት በእኔ ላይ እጅግ ወንጅለዋል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: They have belied YAHUAH, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.am: እነርሱም። እርሱ አይደለም፥ ክፉ ነገርም አይመጣብንም ሰይፍንና ራብንም አናይም፤ ነቢያትም ነፋስ ይሆናሉ፥

verses.en: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእነርሱ ዘንድ የለም፥ እንዲህም ይደረግባቸዋል ብለው እግዚአብሔርን ክደዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህ ቃል ተናግራችኋልና እነሆ፥ በአፍህ ውስጥ ቃሌን እሳት ይህንም ሕዝብ እንጨት አደርጋለሁ፥ ትበላቸውማለች።

verses.en: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Yisra'el, saith YAHUAH: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ሕዝብን ከሩቅ አመጣባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ኃያል ጥንታዊ ሕዝብ ነው፥ ቋንቋቸውንም የማታውቀው የሚናገሩትንም የማታስተውለው ሕዝብ ነው።

verses.en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
verses.am: የፍላጻቸውም ሰገባ እንደ ተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ ሁሉም ኃያላን ናቸው።

verses.en: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
verses.am: መከርህንና እንጀራህን ይበላሉ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህንም ይበሉአቸዋል፤ በጎችህንና ላሞችህንም ይበላሉ፤ ወይንህንና በለስህንም ይበላሉ፤ የምትታመናቸውን የተመሸጉ ከተሞችን በሰይፍ ይደበድባሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless in those days, saith YAHUAH, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዚያ ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ፈጽሜ አላጠፋችሁም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth YAHUAH our YAHUAH all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange elohim in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ። አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ስለምን አደረገብን? ብትሉ፥ አንተ። እንደ ተዋችሁኝ በአገራችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት እንዳመለካችሁ፥ እንዲሁ ለእናንተ ባልሆነ አገር ለሌሎች ሰዎች ትገዛላችሁ ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Declare this in the house of Ya'aqob, and publish it in Yehudah, saying,
verses.am: ይህን በያዕቆብ ቤት አውሩ፥ በይሁዳም አሰሙ።

verses.en: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
verses.am: እናንተ ሰነፎች ልበ ቢሶች፥ ዓይን እያላችሁ የማታዩ፥ ጆሮም እያላችሁ የማትሰሙ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ።

verses.en: Fear ye not me? saith YAHUAH: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.am: በውኑ እኔን አትፈሩምን? ከፊቴስ አትደነግጡምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እንዳያልፍ አሸዋን በዘላለም ትእዛዝ ለባሕር ዳርቻ አድርጌአለሁ፤ ሞገዱም ቢናወጥ አያሸንፍም፥ ቢጮኽም አያልፍበትም።

verses.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.am: ለዚህ ሕዝብ ግን የሸፈተና ያመፀ ልብ አላቸው፤ ዐምፀዋል ሄደውማል።

verses.en: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear YAHUAH our YAHUAH, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.am: በልባቸውም። የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን ዝናብ በጊዜው የሚሰጠውን፥ ለመከርም የተመደቡትን ወራት የሚጠብቅልንን አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን እንፍራ አላሉም።

verses.en: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
verses.am: በደላችሁ እነዚህን አስቀርታለች፥ ኃጢአታችሁም መልካምን ነገር ከለከለቻችሁ።

verses.en: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.am: በሕዝቤ መካከል ክፉዎች ሰዎች ተገኝተዋል፤ እንደ አጥማጆችም ያደባሉ፥ ወጥመድንም ይዘረጋሉ ሰዎችንም ያጠምዳሉ።

verses.en: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
verses.am: ቀፎ ወፎችን እንደሚሞላ፥ እንዲሁ ቤታቸው ሽንገላን ሞልታለች፤እንዲሁም ከብረዋል ባለ ጠጎችም ሆነዋል።

verses.en: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.am: ወፍረዋል ሰብተውማል፥ ክፋታቸውንም ያለ ልክ አብዝተዋል፤ የድሀ አደጎች ነገር መልካም እንዲሆን አልተምዋገቱላቸውም፥ የችግረኞችንም ፍርድ አልፈረዱላቸውም።

verses.en: Shall I not visit for these things? saith YAHUAH: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
verses.am: የምታስደንቅና የምታስደነግጥ ነገር በምድር ላይ ሆናለች፤

verses.en: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.am: ነቢያት በሐሰት ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፥ ካህናትም በእነዚህ እጅ ይገዛሉ፥ ሕዝቤም እንዲህ ያለውን ነገር ይወድዳሉ፤ በፍጻሜውስ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ?

verses.en: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Yerushalayim, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.am: እናንተ የብንያም ልጆች፥ ክፉ ነገር ታላቅም ጥፋት ከሰሜን ይጐበኛልና ከኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ሽሹ፥ በቴቁሔ መለከቱን ንፉ፥ በቤትሐካሪም ላይ ምልክት አንሡ።

verses.en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
verses.am: የተዋበችውንና የተሰባቀለችውን የጽዮንን ልጅ አጐሰቍላለሁ።

verses.en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.am: እረኞችና መንጐቻቸው ወደ እርስዋ ይመጣሉ፥ በዙሪያዋም ድንኳኖቻቸውን ይተክሉባታል፥ እያንዳንዱም በስፍራው መንጋውን ያሰማራል።

verses.en: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.am: በእርስዋ ላይ ሰልፍ አዘጋጁ ተነሡ፥ በቀትርም እንውጣ። ቀኑ መሽቶአልና፥ የማታውም ጥላ ረዝሞአልና ወዮልን።

verses.en: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.am: ተነሡ በሌሊትም እንውጣ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም እናፍርስ።

verses.en: For thus hath YAHUAH of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Yerushalayim: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ዛፎችዋን ቍረጡ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ አፈርን ደልድሉ፤ ይህች ከተማ የምትቀሠፍ ናት፤ መካከልዋ ሁሉ ግፍ ብቻ ነው።

verses.en: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
verses.am: በጕድጓድ ውኃ እንደሚፈልቅ፥ እንዲሁ ክፋትዋ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ ይፈልቃል፤ ግፍና ቅሚያ በእርስዋ ዘንድ ይሰማል፥ ደዌና ቍስልም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አለ።

verses.en: Be thou instructed, O Yerushalayim, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ነፍሴ ከአንቺ እንዳትለይ፥ አንቺንም ባድማና ወና እንዳላደርግሽ፥ ተግሣጽን ተቀበዪ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Yisra'el as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰው ወይኑን እንደሚቃርም፥ እንዲሁ ከእስራኤል የቀሩትን ፈጽሞ ይቃርሙአቸዋል፤ እጅህንም እንደ ለቃሚ ወደ እንቅብ ዘርጋ።

verses.en: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of YAHUAH is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.am: ይሰሙኝስ ዘንድ ለማን እናገራለሁ? ለማንስ አስጠነቅቃለሁ? እነሆ፥ ጆሮአቸው ያልተገረዘች ናት ለመስማትም አይችሉም፤ እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ለስድብ ሆኖባቸዋል፥ ደስም አያሰኛቸውም።

verses.en: Therefore I am full of the fury of YAHUAH; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ተሞልቻለሁ፤ ከመታገሥ ደክሜአለሁ፤ በሜዳ በሕፃናት ላይ በጕልማሶችም ጉባዔ ላይ በአንድነት አፍስሰው፤ ባል ከሚስቱ ጋር ሽማግሌውም ከጎበዙ ጋር ይያያዛልና።

verses.en: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እጄን በምድር በሚኖሩ ላይ እዘረጋለሁና ቤቶቻቸው እርሻዎቻቸውም ሴቶቻቸውም በአንድነት ለሌሎች ይሆናሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.am: ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ስስትን ያስባሉና፥ ከነቢዩም ጀምሮ እስከ ካህኑ ድረስ ሁሉ በተንኰል ያደርጋሉና።

verses.en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.am: የሕዝቤንም ስብራት በጥቂቱ ይፈውሳሉ፤ ሰላም ሳይሆን። ሰላም ሰላም ይላሉ።

verses.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ርኩስን ነገር ስለ ሠሩ አፍረዋልን? ምንም አላፈሩም፥ እፍረትንም አላወቁም፤ ስለዚህ ከሚወድቁ ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ በጐበኘኋቸው ጊዜ ይዋረዳሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመንገድ ላይ ቁሙ ተመልከቱም፥ የቀደመችውንም መንገድ ጠይቁ፤ መልካሚቱ መንገድ ወዴት እንደ ሆነች እወቁ፥ በእርስዋም ላይ ሂዱ፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን። አንሄድባትም አሉ።

verses.en: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.am: እኔም። የመለከቱን ድምፅ አድምጡ ብዬ ጠባቆችን ሾምሁባችሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን። አናደምጥም አሉ።

verses.en: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ ስለዚህ ስሙ፤ ማኅበር ሆይ፥ እነዚያ የሚያገኛቸውን እወቁ።

verses.en: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.am: ምድር ሆይ፥ ስሚ፤ እነሆ፥ ቃሌን ስላልሰሙ ሕጌንም ስለ ጣሉ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ የአሳባቸውን ፍሬ ክፉን ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.am: ስለ ምንስ ከሳባ ዕጣንን፥ ከሩቅም አገር ቀረፋን ታቀርቡልኛላችሁ? የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን አልቀበለውም ሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁም ደስ አያሰኘኝም።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት ዕንቅፋቶችን አደርጋለሁ፤ አባቶችና ልጆች በአንድነት ይሰናከሉባቸዋል፥ ጎረቤትና ባልንጀራም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ ከሰሜን አገር ይመጣል፥ ታላቅ ሕዝብም ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣል።

verses.en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.am: ቀስትንና ጦርን ይይዛሉ፤ ጨካኞች ናቸው፥ ምሕረትንም አያደርጉም፤ ድምፃቸው እንደ ባሕር ይተምማል፥ በፈረሶችም ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ሰው እያንዳንዳቸው በአንቺ ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.am: ወሬውን ሰምተናል፥ እጃችን ደክማለች፤ ምጥ ወላድን ሴት እንደሚይዛት ጭንቀት ይዞናል።

verses.en: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
verses.am: የጠላት ሰይፍና ድንጋጤ ከብበዋችኋልና ወደ ሜዳ አትውጡ በምንገድም ላይ አትሂዱ።

verses.en: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.am: የሕዝቤ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማቅ ልበሺ በአመድም ውስጥ ተንከባለዪ፤ አጥፊ በላያችን በድንገት ይመጣብናልና ለአንድያ ልጅ እንደሚደረግ ልቅሶ፥ መራራ ልቅሶ አልቅሺ።

verses.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.am: መንገዳቸውን እንድታውቅና እንድትፈትን በሕዝቤ መካከል ፈታኝ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
verses.am: እነርሱ ሁሉ እጅግ ዓመፀኞች ናቸው፤ በጠማማነት ይሄዳሉ፤ ናስና ብረት ናቸው፤ ሁሉ ርኵሰትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.am: ወናፍ አናፋ እርሳሱም በእሳት ቀለጠ፤ አንጥረኛውም መልሶ በከንቱ ያቀልጠዋል፤ ኃጢአተኞች አልተወገዱም።

verses.en: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because YAHUAH hath rejected them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጥሎአቸዋልና የተጣለ ብር ብለው ይጠሩአቸዋል።

verses.en: The word that came to Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Stand in the gate of YAHUAH's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of YAHUAH, all ye of Yehudah, that enter in at these gates to worship YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር ቁም፥ ይህንም ቃል እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገር። እግዚአብሔርን ልታመልኩ በእነዚህ በሮች የምትገቡ ከይሁዳ ያላችሁ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን አሳምሩ በዚህም ስፍራ አሳድራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of YAHUAH, The temple of YAHUAH, The temple of YAHUAH, are these.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ይህ ነው እያላችሁ በሐሰት ቃል አትታመኑ።

verses.en: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.am: መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን ፈጽማችሁ ብታሳምሩ፥ በሰውና በጎረቤቱ መካከል ቅን ፍርድ ብትፈርዱ፥

verses.en: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other elohim to your hurt:
verses.am: መጻተኛውንና ድሀ አደጉን መበለቲቱንም ባትገፉ፥ በዚህም ስፍራ ንጹሕ ደምን ባታፈስሱ፥ ክፉም ሊሆንባችሁ እንግዶችን አማልክት ባትከተሉ፥

verses.en: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.am: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ለአባቶቻችሁ በሰጠኋቸው ምድር በዚህ ስፍራ አሳድራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በማትረቡበት በሐሰት ቃል ታምናችኋል።

verses.en: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other elohim whom ye know not;
verses.am: ትሰርቃላችሁ፥ ትገድላላችሁ፥ ታመነዝራላችሁ፥ በሐሰትም ትምላላችሁ፥ ለበኣልም ታጥናላችሁ፥ የማታውቋቸውንም እንግዶች አማልክት ትከተላላችሁ፤

verses.en: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
verses.am: መጣችሁም፥ ስሜም በተጠራበት በዚህ ቤት በፊቴ ቆማችሁ። ይህን አስጸያፊ የሆነ ነገርን ሁሉ አላደረግንም አላችሁ።

verses.en: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይህስ ስሜ የተጠራበት ቤት በዓይናችሁ የሌቦች ዋሻ ሆኖአልን? እነሆ፥ እኔ አይቻለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Yisra'el.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በቀድሞ ዘመን ስሜን ወዳሳደርሁበት በሴሎ ወደ ነበረው ስፍራዬ ሂዱ፥ ከሕዝቤም ከእስራኤል ክፋት የተነሣ ያደረግሁበትን እዩ።

verses.en: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith YAHUAH, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.am: አሁንም ይህን ነገር ሁሉ ስላደረጋችሁ፥ በማለዳም ተነሥቼ በተናገርኋችሁ ጊዜ ስላልሰማችሁ፥ በጠራኋችሁም ጊዜ ስላልመለሳችሁ፥

verses.en: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በሴሎ እንዳደረግሁ እንዲሁ ስሜ በተጠራበት በምትታመኑበት ቤት ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም በሰጠኋችሁ ስፍራ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምንም ዘር ሁሉ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁን ሁሉ እንደ ጣልሁ፥ እንዲሁ ከፊቴ እጥላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
verses.am: እንግዲህም አልሰማህምና ስለዚህ ሕዝብ አትጸልይ ስለ እነርሱም ልመናና ጸሎት አታድርግ፤ አትማልድላቸው።

verses.en: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Yehudah and in the streets of Yerushalayim?
verses.am: እነርሱስ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ውስጥና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ላይ የሚያደርጉትን አታይምን?

verses.en: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other elohim, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.am: ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ፥ ለሰማይ ንግሥት እንጐቻ እንዲያደርጉ ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥ ቍርባን እንዲያፈስሱ ልጆች እንጨት ይሰበስባሉ፥ አባቶችም እሳት ያነድዳሉ፥ ሴቶችም ዱቄት ይለውሳሉ።

verses.en: Do they provoke me to anger? saith YAHUAH: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.am: እኔን ያስቈጣሉን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለፊታቸውስ እፍረት አይደለምን?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.am: እንግዲህም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ቍጣዬና መዓቴ በዚህ ስፍራ ላይ፥ በሰውና በእንስሳ ላይ፥ በዱር ዛፎችና በምድር ፍሬ ላይ ይፈስሳል፤ ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋምም።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለሌላ መሥዋዕታችሁ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁን ጨምሩ፥ ሥጋውንም ብሉ።

verses.en: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Mitsrayim, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
verses.am: ከግብጽ ምድር ባወጣኋችሁ ቀን ስለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ስለ ሌላ መሥዋዕት ለአባቶቻችሁ አልተናገርሁምና፥ አላዘዝኋቸውምም።

verses.en: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your YAHUAH, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። ቃሌን ስሙ፥ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ እናንተም ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ፤ መልካምም ይሆንላችሁ ዘንድ ባዘዝኋችሁ መንገድ ሁሉ ሂዱ ብዬ በዚህ ነገር አዘዝኋቸው።

verses.en: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በክፉ ልባቸው አሳብና እልከኝነት ሄዱ ወደ ፊትም ሳይሆን ወደ ኋላቸው ሄዱ እንጂ አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም።

verses.en: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Mitsrayim unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁ ከግብጽ ምድር ከወጡበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ፥ በየዕለቱ እየማለድሁ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ልኬባችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ እንጂ አልሰሙኝም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም፤ አባቶቻቸውም ካደረጉት ይልቅ የባሰ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.am: በዚህም ቃል ሁሉ ትነግራቸዋለህ፥ ነገር ግን አይሰሙህም፤ ትጠራቸውማለህ፥ ነገር ግን አይመልሱልህም።

verses.en: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of YAHUAH their YAHUAH, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.am: አንተም። የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ያልሰማ፥ ተግሣጽንም ያልተቀበለ ሕዝብ ይህ ነው፤ እውነት ጠፍቶአል ከአፋቸውም ተቈርጦአል ትላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Cut off thine hair, O Yerushalayim, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for YAHUAH hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የቍጣውን ትውልድ ጥሎአልና፥ ትቶታልምና ጠጕርሽን ቍረጪ፥ ጣዪውም፥ በወናዎች ኮረብቶችም ላይ አሙሺ።

verses.en: For the children of Yehudah have done evil in my sight, saith YAHUAH: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆች በፊቴ ክፉን ነገር ሠርተዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ያረክሱትም ዘንድ ስሜ በተጠራበት ቤት ርኵሰታቸውን አኑረዋል።

verses.en: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
verses.am: እኔም ያላዘዝሁትንና በልቤ ያላሰብሁትን፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ያቃጥሉ ዘንድ በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ያለችውን የቶፌትን መስገጃዎች ሠረተዋል።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ስፍራ ከማጣት የተነሣ በቶፌት ይቀበራሉና የእርድ ሸለቆ ይባላል እንጂ ቶፌት ወይም የሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ዳግመኛ የማይባልበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
verses.am: የዚህም ሕዝብ ሬሳ ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናል፥ የሚያስፈራራቸውም የለም።

verses.en: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Yehudah, and from the streets of Yerushalayim, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም ባድማ ትሆናለችና ከይሁዳ ከተሞችና ከኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ የእልልታን ድምፅና የደስታን ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራን ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራን ድምፅ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: At that time, saith YAHUAH, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Yehudah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, out of their graves:
verses.am: በዚያን ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የይሁዳን ነገሥታት አጥንትና የመኳንንቶቹን አጥንት፥ የካህናቱን አጥንትና የነቢያቱን አጥንት፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ሰዎች አጥንት ከመቃብራቸው ያወጣሉ።

verses.en: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.am: በወደዱአቸውና ባመለኩአቸው፥ በተከተሉአቸውና በፈለጉአቸው፥ በሰገዱላቸውም በፀሐይና በጨረቃ በሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ፊት ይዘረጉአቸዋል፤ አያከማቹአቸውም አይቀብሩአቸውምም፥ በምድርም ፊት ላይ እንደ ጕድፍ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith YAHUAH of hosts.
verses.am: እኔም ባሳደድኋቸው ስፍራ ሁሉ የቀሩ፥ ከዚህች ክፉ ወገን የተረፉ ቅሬታዎች ሁሉ፥ ከሕይወት ይልቅ ሞትን ይመርጣሉ።

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.am: እንዲህም ትላቸዋለሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የወደቁ አይነሡምን? የሳተስ አይመለስምን?

verses.en: Why then is this people of Yerushalayim slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ይህ የኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ ዘወትር ስለ ምን ወደ ኋላው ይመለሳል? ተንኰልን ይዞአል ሊመለስም እንቢ ብሎአል።

verses.en: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
verses.am: አደመጥሁ ሰማሁም፤ ቅንን ነገር አልተናገሩም፤ ማናቸውንም። ምን አድርጌአለሁ? ብሎ ከክፋቱ ንስሐ የገባ የለም፤ ወደ ሰልፍም እንደሚሮጥ ፈረስ እያንዳንዱ በየመንገዱ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሽመላ በሰማይ ጊዜዋን አውቃለች፤ ዋኖስና ጨረባ ዋልያም የመምጣታቸውን ጊዜ ይጠብቃሉ፤ ሕዝቤ ግን የእግዚአብሔርን ፍርድ አላወቁም።

verses.en: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of YAHUAH is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
verses.am: እናንተስ። ጥበበኞች ነን የእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ ከእኛ ጋር ነው እንዴት ትላላችሁ? እነሆ፥ የጸሐፊ ብርዕ ሐሰተኛ ነው በሐሰትም አድርጎአል።

verses.en: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of YAHUAH; and what wisdom is in them?
verses.am: ጥበበኞች አፍረዋል ደንግጠውማል ተማርከውማል፤ እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ጥለዋል፤ ምን ዓይነት ጥበብ አላቸው?

verses.en: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.am: ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ስስትን ያስባሉና፥ ከነቢዩም ጀምሮ እስከ ካህኑ ድረስ ሁሉ በተንኰል ያደርጋሉና ስለዚህ ሚስቶቻቸውን ለሌሎች፥ እርሻቸውንም ለሚወርሱባቸው እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.am: የሕዝቤንም ሴት ልጅ ስብራት በጥቂቱ ይፈውሳሉ፤ ሰላም ሳይሆን። ስለም ሰላም ይላሉ።

verses.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: አስጸያፊ ነገርን ስለ ሠሩ አፍረዋልን? ምንም አላፈሩም፥ እፍረትንም አላወቁም፤ ስለዚህ ከሚወድቁ ጋር ይወድቃሉ፤ በጐበኘኋቸው ጊዜ ይዋረዳሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር

verses.en: I will surely consume them, saith YAHUAH: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
verses.am: ፈጽሜ አጠፋችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በወይን ላይ ፍሬ፥ በበለስ ዛፍ ላይ በለስ አይሆንም፥ ቅጠልም ይረግፋል፤ የሚያልፉባቸውንም ሰጠኋቸው።

verses.en: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for YAHUAH our YAHUAH hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against YAHUAH.
verses.am: ዝም ብለን ለም እንቀመጣለን? እግዚአብሔርን ስለ በደልን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር አጥፍቶናልና፥ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጥቶናልና ተሰብስባችሁ ወደ ተመሸጉ ከተሞች እንግባ በዚያም እንጥፋ።

verses.en: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
verses.am: ሰላምን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ መልካምም አልተገኘም፤ መጠገንን በተስፋ ተጠባበቅን፥ እነሆም፥ ድንጋጤ ሆነ።

verses.en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
verses.am: የፈረሰኞቹ ድምጽ ከዳን ተሰማ፤ ከአርበኞች ፈረሶች ማሽካካት የተነሣ ምድር ሁሉ ተንቀጠቀጠች፤ መጡም ምድሪቱንና በእርስዋም ያለውን ሁሉ፥ ከተማይቱንና የተቀመጡባትንም በሉ።

verses.en: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አስማት የማይከለክላቸውን እባቦችንና እፉኝቶችን እሰድድባችኋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ይነድፉአችኋል።

verses.en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
verses.am: ኅዘኔ የማይጽናና ነው፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደክሞአል።

verses.en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not YAHUAH in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
verses.am: እነሆ። እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን የለምን? ወይስ ንጉሥዋ በእርስዋ ዘንድ የለምን? የሚል የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ጩኸት ድምፅ ከሩቅ አገር ተሰማ። በተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውና በባዕድ ከንቱነትስ ያስቈጡኝ ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
verses.am: መከሩ አልፎአል፥ በጋው ሄዶአል፥ እኛም አልዳንነም።

verses.en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
verses.am: በሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ስብራት እኔ ተሰብሬአለሁ ጠKWreማለሁ፤ አድናቆትም ይዞኛል።

verses.en: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
verses.am: በገለዓድ የሚቀባ መድኃኒት የለምን? ወይስ በዚያ ሐኪም የለምን? የወገኔ ሴት ልጅ ፈውስ ስለ ምን አልሆነም?

verses.en: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.am: ተወግተው ስለ ሞቱ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ሰዎች ሌሊትና ቀን አለቅስ ዘንድ ራሴ ውኃ፥ ዓይኔም የእንባ ምንጭ በሆነልኝ!

verses.en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
verses.am: ሁሉም አመንዝሮች፥ የአታላዮች ጉባኤ ናቸውና ሕዝቤን እተዋቸው ዘንድ ከእነርሱም እለይ ዘንድ በምድረ በዳ የመንገደኞች ማደሪያን ማን በሰጠኝ?

verses.en: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ምላሳቸውን ስለ ሐሰት እንደ ቀስት ገተሩ፤ በምድር በረቱ ነገር ግን ለእውነት አይደለም፤ ከክፋት ወደ ክፋት ይሄዳሉና እኔንም አላወቁምና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
verses.am: ወንድምም ሁሉ ያሰናክላልና፥ ባልንጀራም ሁሉ ያማልና እናንተ ሁሉ ከባልንጀሮቻችሁ ተጠንቀቁ፥ በወንድሞቻችሁም አትታመኑ።

verses.en: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
verses.am: ሰውም ሁሉ ባልንጀራውን ያታልላል በእውነትም አይናገርም፤ ሐሰትን መናገርንም ምላሳቸው ተምሮአል፥ ክፉንም ለማድረግ ይደክማሉ።

verses.en: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ማደሪያህ በሽንገላ መካከል ነው፥ ከሽንገላም የተነሣ እኔን ያውቁኝ ዘንድ እንቢ ብለዋል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ አቀልጣቸዋለሁ እፈትናቸውማለሁ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ሴት ልጅ ክፋት ከዚህ ሌላ የማደርገው ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
verses.am: ምላሳቸው የተሳለ ፍላጻ ነው፤ ሽንገላን ይናገራሉ ሰው ከባልንጀራው ጋር በሰላም ይናገራል፥ በልቡ ግን ያደባበታል።

verses.en: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith YAHUAH: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለዚህ ነገር አልቀሥፍምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነፍሴስ እንደዚህ ባለ ሕዝብ ላይ አትበቀልምን?

verses.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
verses.am: ለተራሮች ልቅሶን ለምድረ በዳ ማሰማርያዎችም ዋይታን አነሣለሁ፥ ሰው እንዳያልፍባቸው በእሳት ተቃጥለዋልና። ሰዎችም የከብቱን ድምፅ አይሰሙም፤ ከሰማይ ወፎች ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ሸሽተው ሄደዋል።

verses.en: And I will make Yerushalayim heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Yehudah desolate, without an inhabitant.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌምንም የፍርስራሽ ክምር የቀበሮም ማደሪያ አደርጋታለሁ፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ሰው የማይቀመጥባት ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of YAHUAH hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
verses.am: ይህን የሚያስተውል ጠቢብ ሰው ማን ነው? ያወራስ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ለማን ተናገረ? ሰው እንዳያልፍባት ምድርስ ስለምን ጠፋች፥ እንደ ምድረ በዳስ ስለ ምን ተቃጠለች?

verses.en: And YAHUAH saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለ። የሰጠኋቸውን ሕጌን ትተዋልና፥ ቃሌንም አልሰሙምና፥

verses.en: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
verses.am: ነገር ግን የልባቸውን ምኞትና አባቶቻቸው ያስተማሩአቸውን በኣሊምን ተከትለዋልና

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህን ሕዝብ እሬትን አበላዋለሁ የሐሞትንም ውኃ አጠጣዋለሁ።

verses.en: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
verses.am: እነርሱና አባቶቻቸውም ባላወቁአቸው አሕዛብ መካከል እበትናቸዋለሁ፥ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ በስተ ኋላቸው ሰይፍን እሰድድባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲመጡ አልቃሾች ሴቶችን ጥሩ፤ እንዲመጡም ወደ ብልሃተኞች ሴቶች ላኩ፤

verses.en: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
verses.am: ዓይኖቻችንም እንባ እንዲያፈስሱ የዓይናችንም ሽፋሽፍቶች ውኃን እንዲያፈልቁ ፈጥነው ለእኛ ልቅሶውን ይያዙ።

verses.en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
verses.am: በጽዮን። እንዴት ተበዘበዝን! ምድርንም ትተናልና፥ ቤቶቻችንንም አፍርሰዋልና እንዴት አፈርን! የሚል የልቅሶ ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Yet hear the word of YAHUAH, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
verses.am: እናንተ ሴቶች ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፥ ጆሮአችሁም የአፉን ቃል ትቀበል፥ ለሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ልቅሶውን፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ለባልንጀሮቻችሁ ዋይታውን አስተምሩ።

verses.en: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
verses.am: ሕፃናቱን ከመንገድ ጕልማሶቹንም ከአደባባይ ያጠፉ ዘንድ ሞት ወደ መስኮታችን ደርሶአል ወደ አዳራሻችንም ውስጥ ገብቶአል።

verses.en: Speak, Thus saith YAHUAH, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
verses.am: የሰውም ሬሳ እንደ ጕድፍ በእርሻ ላይ፥ ማንምም እንደማይሰበስበው ከአጫጆች በኋላ እንደሚቀር ቃርሚያ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጠቢብ በጥበቡ አይመካ፥ ኃያልም በኃይሉ አይመካ፥ ባለ ጠጋም በብልጥግናው አይመካ፤

verses.en: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am YAHUAH which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሚመካው። ምሕረትንና ፍርድን ጽድቅንም በምድር ላይ የማደርግ እኔ እግዚአብሔር መሆኔን በማወቁና በማስተዋሉ በዚህ ይመካ፤ ደስ የሚያሰኙኝ እነዚህ ናቸውና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;

Mitsrayim, and Yehudah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Yisra'el are uncircumcised in the heart.
Hear ye the word which YAHUAH speaketh unto you, O house of Yisra'el:
verses.am: እናንተ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእናንተ ላይ የተናገረውን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሕዛብን መንገድ አትማሩ ከሰማይ ምልክትም አትፍሩ፤ አሕዛብ ይፈሩታልና።

verses.en: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ልማድ ከንቱ ነውና፤ ዛፍ ከዱር ይቈረጣል፥ በሠራተኛም እንጅ በመጥረቢያ ይሠራል።

verses.en: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.am: በብርና በወርቅ ያስጌጡታል፥ እንዳይናወጥም በችንካርና በመዶሻ ይቸነክሩታል።

verses.en: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
verses.am: እንደ ተቀረጸ ዓምድ ናቸው እነርሱም አይናገሩም፤ መራመድም አይቻላቸውማን ይሸከሙአቸዋል። ክፉ መሥራትም አይቻላቸውምና፥ ደግምም መልካም ይሠሩ ዘንድ አይችሉምና አትፍሩአቸው።

verses.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O YAHUAH; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ የለም፤ አንተ ታላቅ ነህ ስምህም በኃይል ታላቅ ነው።

verses.en: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በአሕዛብ ጥበበኞች ሁሉ መካከል በመንግሥታቸውም ሁሉ እንደ አንተ ያለ ስለሌለ፥ አንተን መፍራት ይገባልና አንተን የማይፈራ ማን ነው?

verses.en: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
verses.am: በአንድ ጊዜ ሰንፈዋል፥ ደንቍረውማል፤ ጣዖታት የሚያስተምሩት የእንጨት ነገር ብቻ ነው።

verses.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
verses.am: የሠራተኛና የአንጥረኛ እጅ ሥራ የሆነ ከተርሴስ ጥፍጥፍ ብር ከአፌዝም ወርቅ ይመጣል፤ ልብሳቸውም ሰማያዊና ቀይ ግምጃ ነው፥ ሁሉም የብልሃተኞች ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: But YAHUAH is the true YAHUAH, he is the living YAHUAH, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እውነተኛ አምላክ ነው፤ እርሱም ሕያው አምላክና የዘላለም ንጉሥ ነው፤ ከቍጣው የተነሣ ምድር ትንቀጠቀጣለች፤ አሕዛብም መዓቱን አይችሉም።

verses.en: Thus shall ye say unto them, The elohim that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.am: እናንተም። ሰማይንና ምድርን ያልፈጠሩ እነዚህ አማልክት ከምድር ላይ ከሰማይም በታች ይጠፋሉ ትሉአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.am: ምድርን በኃይሉ የፈጠረ፥ ዓለሙን በጥበቡ የመሠረተ ሰማያትንም በማስተዋሉ የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.am: ድምፁን ባሰማ ጊዜ ውኆች በሰማይ ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ከምድርም ዳር ደመናትን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ ለዝናቡም መብረቅን ያደርጋል፥ ነፋስንም ከቤተ መዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ እውቀት አጥቶ ሰንፎአል፥ አንጥረኛም ሁሉ ከቀረጸው ምስል የተነሣ አፍሮአል፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስሉ ውሸት ነውና፥ እስትንፋስም የላቸውምና።

verses.en: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.am: እነርሱ ምናምንቴና የቀልድ ሥራ ናቸው፤ በተጐበኙ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The portion of Ya'aqob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Yisra'el is the rod of his inheritance: YAHUAH of hosts is his name.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ እድል ፈንታ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፤ እርሱ የሁሉ ፈጣሪ ነውና፤ እስራኤልም የርስቱ ነገድ ነውና፤ ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
verses.am: በምሽግ ውስጥ የተቀመጥሽ ሆይ፥ ዕቃሽን ከመሬት ሰብስቢ፤

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩትን እስኪሰማቸው ድረስ በዚህ ጊዜ እወነጭፋቸዋለሁ፥ አስጨንቃቸውማለሁ።

verses.en: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.am: ስለ ስብራቴ ወዮልኝ! ቍስሌም ክፉ ነው፥ እኔ ግን። በእውነት የመከራ ቍስሌ ነው እርሱንም መሸከም ይገባኛል አልሁ።

verses.en: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.am: ድንኳኔ ተበዘበዘ አውታሬም ሁሉ ተቈረጠ፤ ልጆቼም ከእኔ ወጥተው አይገኙም፤ ድንኳኔንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሚዘረጋ መጋረጃዎችንም የሚያነሣ የለም።

verses.en: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought YAHUAH: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.am: እረኞች ሰንፈዋልና፥ እግዚአብሔርን አልጠየቁትምና አልተከናወነላቸውም፥ መንጎቻቸውም ሁሉ ተበትነዋል።

verses.en: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Yehudah desolate, and a den of dragons.
verses.am: የወሬን ድምፅ ስሙ፤ እነሆም፥ የይሁዳን ከተሞች ባድማና የቀበሮ ማደሪያ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ ከሰሜን ምድር ጽኑ ሽብር መጥቶአል።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሰው መንገድ ከራሱ እንዳይደለ አውቃለሁ፥ አካሄዱንም ለማቅናት ከሚራመድ ሰው አይደለም።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቅጣኝ፤ ነገር ግን እንዳታዋርደኝ በመጠን ይሁን እንጂ በቍጣ አይሁን።

verses.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Ya'aqob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.am: ያዕቆብን በልተውታልና፥ ውጠውትማልና፥ አጥፍተውትማልና፥ ማደሪያውንም አፍርሰዋልና በማያውቁህ አሕዛብ ስምህንም በማይጠሩ ወገኖች ላይ መዓትህን አፍስስ።

verses.en: The word that came to Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Yehudah, and to the inhabitants of Yerushalayim;
verses.am: የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ስማ፥ ለይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖሩ ተናገር፥

verses.en: And say thou unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Mitsrayim, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your YAHUAH:
verses.am: እንደዚህም በላቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከግብጽ አገር ከብረት ምድጃ ባወጣኋቸው ቀን ለአባቶቻችሁ ያዘዝሁትን የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል የማይሰማ ሰው ርጉም ይሁን፤ አልሁም። ቃሌን ስሙ፥ ያዘዝኋችሁንም ሁሉ አድርጉ፤ እንዲሁም እናንተ ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይህም ዛሬ እንደ ሆነ ወተትና ማር የምታፈስሰውን ምድር እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችሁ የማልሁትን መሐላ አጸና ዘንድ ነው። እኔም። አቤቱ፥ አሜን ብዬ መለስሁለት።

verses.en: Then YAHUAH said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Yehudah, and in the streets of Yerushalayim, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ይህችን ቃል ሁሉ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ተናገር፥ እንዲህም በል። የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ስሙ አድርጉትም።

verses.en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Mitsrayim, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁን ከግብጽ ምድር ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ፥ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ እያስጠነቀቅሁ። ቃሌን ስሙ በማለት አስጠንቅቄአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.
verses.am: እነርሱ ሁሉ ግን በክፉ ልባቸው እልከኝነት ሄዱ እንጂ አልሰሙም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም፤ ስለዚህ ያዘዝኋቸውን እነርሱም ያላደረጉትን የዚህን ቃል ኪዳን ቃል ሁሉ አመጣሁባቸው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Yehudah, and among the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። በይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖሩ ዘንድ አድማ ተገኝቶአል።

verses.en: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other elohim to serve them: the house of Yisra'el and the house of Yehudah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.am: ቃሌንም ይሰሙ ዘንድ እንቢ ወዳሉ ወደ አባቶቻቸው ኃጢአት ተመለሱ፥ ያመልኩአቸውም ዘንድ እንግዶችን አማልክት ተከተሉ፤ የእስራኤል ቤትና የይሁዳ ቤት ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር ያደረግሁትን ቃል ኪዳን አፈረሱ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሊያመልጡት የማይችሉትን ክፉ ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ወደ እኔም ይጮኻሉ፤ እኔም አልሰማቸውም።

verses.en: Then shall the cities of Yehudah and inhabitants of Yerushalayim go, and cry unto the elohim unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩ ሄደው ወደሚያጥኑላቸው አማልክት ይጮኻሉ፤ ነገር ግን በመከራቸው ጊዜ ከቶ አያድኑአቸውም።

verses.en: For according to the number of thy cities were thy elohim, O Yehudah; and according to the number of the streets of Yerushalayim have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
verses.am: ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ አማልክትህ እንደ ከተሞችህ ቍጥር እንዲሁ ናቸው፤ እንደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መንገዶች ቍጥር ለነውረኛ ነገር መሠዊያ፥ እርሱም ለበኣል ታጥኑበት ዘንድ መሠዊያ፥ አድርጋችኋል።

verses.en: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
verses.am: አንተም ስለዚህ ሕዝብ አትጸልይ፤ ከመከራቸው የተነሣ ወደ እኔ በጮኹ ጊዜ አልሰማቸውምና ስለ እነርሱም ጩኸትና ልመና አታድርግ።

verses.en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
verses.am: ወዳጄ በቤቴ ውስጥ ምን አላት? ስእለት ወይም የተቀደሰ ሥጋ ክፋትሽን ከአንቺ ያስወግዳልን? ወይስ በእነዚህ ታመልጫለሽን?

verses.en: YAHUAH called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስምሽን።በመልካም ፍሬ የተዋበች የለመለመች የወይራ ዛፍ ብሎ ጠራው፤ በጽኑ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ጩኸት እሳትን አነደደባት፥ ቅርንጫፎችዋም ተሰብረዋል።

verses.en: For YAHUAH of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Yisra'el and of the house of Yehudah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.am: ለበኣልም በማጠናቸው ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ ለራሳቸው ስለ ሠሩአት ስለ እስራኤልና ስለ ይሁዳ ቤት ክፋት የተከለሽ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ክፉን ነገር ተናግሮብሻል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አስታወቀኝ እኔም አወቅሁ፤ ሥራቸውንም ገለጥህልኝ።

verses.en: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
verses.am: እኔም ለመታረድ እንደሚነዳ እንደ የዋህ በግ ጠቦት ሆንሁ፤ እነርሱም። ዛፉን ከፍሬው ጋር እንቍረጥ፥ ስሙም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንዳይታሰብ ከሕያዋን ምድር እናጥፋው ብለው ምክርን እንዳሰቡብኝ አላወቅሁም ነበር።

verses.en: But, O YAHUAH of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.am: ኵላሊትንና ልብን የምትፈትን በቅንም የምትፈርድ አቤቱ የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክርክሬን ገልጬልሃለሁና በእነርሱ ላይ የሚሆን በቀልህን ለይ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of YAHUAH, that thou die not by our hand:
verses.am: ስለዚህም። በእጃችን እንዳትሞት በእግዚአብሔር ስም ትንቢት አትናገር ብለው ነፍስህን ስለሚሹ ስለ ዓናቶት ሰዎች እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።እነሆ፥ እቀጣቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
verses.am: ጎበዛዝቶቻቸው በሰይፍ ይሞታሉ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም በራብ ይሞታሉ፤ በምጐበኛቸውም ዓመት በዓናቶት ሰዎች ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁና ማንም ከእነርሱ የሚቀር የለም።

verses.en: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

Righteous art thou, O YAHUAH, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከአንተ ጋር በተምዋገትሁ ጊዜ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፤ ነገር ግን ከአንተ ጋር ስለ ፍርድ ልናገር። የኃጢአተኞች መንገድ ስለምን ይቃናል? በደልንስ ለሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ስለምን ደኅንነት ይሆናል?

verses.en: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
verses.am: ተክለሃቸዋል፤ ሥር ሰድደዋል፤ አድገዋል አፍርተውማል፤ በአፋቸው አንተ ቅርብ ነህ፥ ከልባቸው ግን ሩቅ ነህ።

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ አውቀኸኛል፤ አይተኸኛል፥ ልቤንም በፊትህ ፈትነሃል፤ እንደ በጎች ለመታረድ ጐትተህ ለያቸው፥ ለመታረድም ቀን አዘጋጃቸው።

verses.en: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
verses.am: ምድሪቱ የምታለቅሰው፥ የአገሩ ሣርስ ሁሉ የሚደርቀው እስከ መቸ ነው? የተቀመጡባት ሰዎች። ፍጻሜያችንን አያይም ብለዋልና ስለ ክፋታቸው እንስሶችና ወፎች ጠፍተዋል።

verses.en: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
verses.am: ከእግረኞች ጋር በሮጥህ ጊዜ እነርሱ ቢያደክሙህ፥ ከፈረሶች ጋር መታገል እንዴት ትችላለህ? በሰላምም ምድር ታምነህ ብትቀመጥ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት እንዴት ታደርጋለህ?

verses.en: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
verses.am: ወንድሞችህና የአባትህ ቤት እነርሱ ጭምር አታልለውሃልና፥ በኋላህም ጮኸዋልና፤ በመልካምም ቢናገሩህም አትታመናቸው።

verses.en: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.am: ቤቴን ትቼአለሁ ርስቴንም ጥያለሁ፥ ነፍሴም የምትወድዳትን በጠላቶችዋ እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
verses.am: ርስቴ በዱር እንዳለ አንበሳ ሆናብኛለች፤ ድምፅዋን አንሥታብኛለች፤ ስለዚህ ጠልቻታለሁ።

verses.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
verses.am: ርስቴ እንደ ዝንጕርጕር አሞራ ሆነችብኝን? አሞሮችስ በዙሪያዋና በላይዋ ሆነዋልን? ሂዱ፥ የምድር አራዊትን ሁሉ ሰብስቡ፥ ይበሉም ዘንድ አምጡአቸው።

verses.en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.am: ብዙ እረኞች የወይኑን ቦታዬን አጥፍተዋል፥ እድል ፈንታዬንም ረግጠዋል፤ የአምሮቴን እድል ፈንታ ምድረ በዳ አድርገውታል።

verses.en: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.
