verses.am: የዘምሪ ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የኤላም ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.am: የሜዶን ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ የቀረቡና የራቁ፥ አንዱ ከሌላው ጋር ያሉ የሰሜን ነገሥታትንም ሁሉ፥ በምድር ፊት ላይ ያሉ የዓለም መንግሥታትንም ሁሉ አጠጣኋቸው፤ የሼሻክም ንጉሥ ከእነርሱ በኋላ ይጠጣል።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.am: አንተም። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመካከላችሁ ከምሰድደው ሰይፍ የተነሣ ጠጡ፥ ስከሩም፥ አስታውኩም ውደቁም፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አትነሡም በላቸው።

verses.en: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
verses.am: ይጠጡም ዘንድ ጽዋውን ከእጅህ ለመቀበል እንቢ ቢሉ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ፈጽማችሁ ትጠጣላችሁ በላቸው።

verses.en: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith YAHUAH of hosts.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ስሜ የተጠራባትን ከተማ አስጨንቃት ዘንድ እጀምራለሁ፤ በውኑ እናንተ ያልተቀጣችሁ ትሆናላችሁን? በምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ሰይፍን እጠራለሁና ያለ ቅጣት አትቀሩም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, YAHUAH shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ትንቢት ትናገርባቸዋለህ፥ እንዲህም ትላቸዋለህ። እግዚአብሔር በላይ ሆኖ ይጮኻል፥ በቅዱስ ማደሪያውም ሆኖ ድምፁን ያሰማል፤ በበረቱ ላይ እጅግ ይጮኻል፥ ወይንም እንደሚጠምቁ በምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ይጮኻል።

verses.en: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for YAHUAH hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከአሕዛብ ጋር ክርክር አለውና ድምፅ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ይደርሳል፤ ከሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ጋር ይፋረዳል፥ ኃቲአተኞችንም ለሰይፍ አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገር ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ ይወጣል፥ ጽኑም ዐውሎ ነፍስ ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣል።

verses.en: And the slain of YAHUAH shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ግዳዩች ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ይሆናሉ፤ አይለቀስላቸውም፤ በምድር ላይ እንደ gWdፍ ይሆናሉ እንጂ አይከማቹም አይቀበሩምም።

verses.en: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.am: ትታረዱና ትበተኑ ዘንድ ቀናችሁ ደርሶአልና፥ እንደ ተወደደም የሸክላ ዕቃ ትወድቃላችሁና እናንተ እረኞች፥ አልቅሱ ጩኹም፤ እናንተ የመንጋ አውራዎች፥ በአመድ ውስጥ ተንከባለሉ።

verses.en: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.am: ሽሽትም ከእረኞች ማምለጥም ከመንጋ አውራዎች ይጠፋል።

verses.en: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for YAHUAH hath spoiled their pasture.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ማሰማርያቸውን አጥፍቶአልና የእረኞች ጩኸት ድምፅ የመንጋ አውራዎችም ልቅሶ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ KWTa የተነሣ የሰላም በረት ፈርሶአል።

verses.en: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.am: እንደ አንበሳ መደቡን ለቅቆአል፤ ከአስጨናቂውም ሰይፍና ከጽኑ ቍጣው የተነሣ ምድራቸው ባድማ ሆናለችና።

verses.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yehudah came this word from YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; Stand in the court of YAHUAH's house, and speak unto all the cities of Yehudah, which come to worship in YAHUAH's house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ቁም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ውስጥ ይሰግዱ ዘንድ ለሚመጡት ለይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ትነግራቸው ዘንድ ያዘዝሁህን ቃል ሁሉ ተናገራቸው፤ አንዲትም ቃል አትgWdል።

verses.en: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.am: ምናልባት ይሰሙ፥ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውም ይመለሱ ይሆናል፤ እኔም ስለ ሥራቸው ክፋት ያሰብሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር እተዋለሁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith YAHUAH; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.am: እንዲህም በላቸው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በፊታችሁ በሰጠኋት ሕጌ ትሄዱ ዘንድ ባትሰሙኝ፥

verses.en: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
verses.am: ያልሰማችሁትን በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ወደ እናንተ የላክኋቸውን የባሪያዎቼን የነቢያትን ቃል ባትሰሙ፥

verses.en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.am: ይህን ቤት እንደ ሴሎ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ይህችንም ከተማ ለምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ እርግማን አደርጋታለሁ።

verses.en: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Yirmeyahu speaking these words in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ካህናቱም ነቢያቱም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ኤርምያስ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይህን ቃል ሲናገር ሰሙ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when Yirmeyahu had made an end of speaking all that YAHUAH had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ይናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘውን ነገር ሁሉ በፈጸመ ጊዜ ካህናትና ነቢያት ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ሞትን ትሞታለህ።

verses.en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of YAHUAH, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Yirmeyahu in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ስም። ይህ ቤት እንደ ሴሎ ይሆናል፥ ይህችም ከተማ ባድማና ወና ትሆናለች ብለህ ስለ ምን ትንቢት ተናገርህ? ብለው ያዙት። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በኤርምያስ ላይ ተሰብስበው ነበር።

verses.en: When the princes of Yehudah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of YAHUAH, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of YAHUAH's house.
verses.am: የይሁዳም አለቆች ይህን በሰሙ ጊዜ ከንጉሥ ቤት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጡ፥ በአዲሱም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ደጅ መግቢያ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
verses.am: ካህናቱና ነቢያቱም ለአለቆቹና ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ። በጆሮአችሁ እንደ ሰማችሁ በዚህች ከተማ ላይ ትንቢት ተናግአልና ይህ ሰው ሞት የሚገባው ነው ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Then spake Yirmeyahu unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, YAHUAH sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ለአለቆችና ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ። በሰማችሁት ቃል ሁሉ በዚህች ቤትና በዚህች ከተማ ላይ ትንቢት እናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ልኮኛል።

verses.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of YAHUAH your YAHUAH; and YAHUAH will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
verses.am: አሁንም መንገዳችሁንና ሥራችሁን አሳምሩ፥ የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረባችሁን ክፉ ነገር ይተዋል።

verses.en: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
verses.am: እኔ ግን፥ እነሆ፥ በእጃችሁ ነኝ፤ በዓይናችሁ መልካምና ቅን የመሰለውን አድርጉብኝ።

verses.en: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth YAHUAH hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ በጆሮአችሁ እናገር ዘንድ በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ወደ እናንተ ልኮኛልና ብትገድሉኝ ንጹሕ ደምን በራሳችሁና በዚህች ከተማ በሚኖሩባትም ላይ እንድታመጡ በእርግጥ እወቁ።

verses.en: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: አለቆቹና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ለካህናትና ለነቢያት። ይህ ሰው በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ተናግሮናልና ሞት አይገባውም አሉ።

verses.en: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.am: ከአገሩ ሽማግሌዎችም ሰዎች ተነሥተው ለሕዝቡ ጉባኤ ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Mikah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Yehudah, and spake to all the people of Yehudah, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Yerushalayim shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.am: ሞሬታዊው ሚክያስ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ነቢይ ነበረ፤ ለይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ጽዮን እንደ እርሻ ትታረሳለች፥ ኢየሩሳሌም የፍርስራሽ ክምር ትሆናለች፥ የቤቱም ተራራ እንደ ዱር ከፍታ ይሆናል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Did Hezekiah king of Yehudah and all Yehudah put him at all to death? did he not fear YAHUAH, and besought YAHUAH, and YAHUAH repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
verses.am: በውኑ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ገደሉትን? በውኑ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈሩምን? ወደ እግዚአብሔርስ አልተማለሉምን? እግዚአብሔርስ የተናገረባቸውን ክፉ ነገር አይተውምን? እኛም በነፍሳችን ላይ ታላቅ ክፋት እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of YAHUAH, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Yirmeyahu:
verses.am: ደግሞም በእግዚአብሔር ስም ትንቢት የተናገረ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም የቂርያትይዓሪም ሰው የሸማያ ልጅ ኦርዮ ይባል ነበር፤ በዚህችም ከተማ በዚህችም ምድር ላይ እንደ ኤርምያስ ቃል ሁሉ ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.en: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Mitsrayim;
verses.am: ንጉሡም ኢዮአቄም ኃያላኑም ሁሉ አለቆቹም ሁሉ ቃሉን በሰሙ ጊዜ ንጉሡ ሊገድለው ፈለገ፤ ኦርዮም ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ፈርቶ ሸሸ ወደ ግብጽም ገባ።

verses.en: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Mitsrayim, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Mitsrayim.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ኢዮአቄም የዓክቦርን ልጅ ኤልናታንን ከእርሱም ጋር ሌሎችን ሰዎች ወደ ግብጽ ላካቸው፤

verses.en: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Mitsrayim, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.am: ከግብጽም ኦርዮን አውጥተው ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኢዮአቄም ይዘውት መጡ፤ እርሱም በሰይፍ ገደለው ሬሳውንም ክቡራን ባልሆኑ ሰዎች መቃብር ጣለው።

verses.en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Yirmeyahu, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሕዝቡ እጅ እንዳይሰጥና እንዳይገድሉት የሳፋን ልጅ የአኪቃም እጅ ከኤርምያስ ጋር ነበረች።

verses.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yehudah came this word unto Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ይህ ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይለኛል። እስራትና ቀንበር ሥራ በአንገትህም ላይ አድርግ፤

verses.en: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Yerushalayim unto Zedekiah king of Yehudah;
verses.am: ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥም ወደ ሴዴቅያስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በመጡት መልእክተኞች እጅ ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ ወደ ሞዓብም ንጉሥ ወደ አሞንም ልጆች ንጉሥ ወደ ጢሮስም ንጉሥ ወደ ሲዶናም ንጉሥ ላካቸው።

verses.en: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
verses.am: ለጌቶቻቸውም እንዲነግሩ እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለጌቶቻችሁ እንዲህ በሉ።

verses.en: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን በምድርም ፊት ላይ ያሉትን ሰዎችንና እንስሶችን በታላቅ ኃይሌና በተዘረጋችው ክንዴ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ ለዓይኔም መልካም ለሆነው እሰጣታለሁ።

verses.en: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babel, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
verses.am: አሁንም እነዚህን ምድሮች ሁሉ ለባሪያዬ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ፤ ይገዙለትም ዘንድ የምድረ በዳ አራዊትን ደግሞ ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
verses.am: የገዛ ራሱም ምድር ጊዜ እስኪመጣ ድረስ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለእርሱና ለልጅ ለልጅ ልጁም ይገዛሉ፤ በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙ አሕዛብና ታላላቆች ነገሥታት እርሱን ያስገዙታል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babel, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babel, that nation will I punish, saith YAHUAH, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.am: ለባቢሎን ንጉሥም ለናቡከደነፆር የማይገዛውን፥ ከባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገቱን ዝቅ የማያደርገውን ሕዝብና መንግሥት፥ ያን ሕዝብ በእጁ እስካጠፋው ድረስ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም እቀጣለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babel:
verses.am: እናንተ ግን። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትገዙም የሚሉአችሁን ነቢያቶቻችሁንና ምዋርተኞቻችሁን፥ ሕልም አላሚዎቻችሁንና ቃላተኞቻችሁን መተተኞቻችሁንም አትስሙ፤

verses.en: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
verses.am: ከምድራቸሁ እንዲያርቁአችሁ፥ እኔም እንዳሳድዳችሁ እናንተም እንድትጠፉ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገሩላችኋልና።

verses.en: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babel, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith YAHUAH; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገቱን ዝቅ የሚያደርገውንና የሚገዛለትን ሕዝብ በአገሩ ላይ እተወዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ያርሱአታል ይቀመጡባትማል።

verses.en: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Yehudah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babel, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.am: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስም በዚህ ቃል ተናገርሁ። ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ቀንበር በታች አንገታችሁን ዝቅ አድርጉ ለእርሱና ለሕዝቡም ተገዙላቸው በሕይወትም ኑሩ።

verses.en: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as YAHUAH hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babel?
verses.am: ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ይገዛ ዘንድ እንቢ ስላለ ሕዝብ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረ፥ አንተና ሕዝብህ በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ለምን ትሞታላችሁ?

verses.en: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babel: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ አትገዙም የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያትን ቃል አትስሙ።

verses.en: For I have not sent them, saith YAHUAH, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.am: እኔ አልላክኋቸውምና፤ ነገር ግን እኔ እንዳሳድዳችሁ፥ እናንተና ትንቢት የሚናገሩላችሁ ነቢያትም እንድትጠፉ በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገራሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of YAHUAH's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babel: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.am: ለካህናትም ለዚህም ሕዝብ እንዲህ ብዬ ተናገርሁ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሐሰተኛውን ትንቢት ይናገሩላችኋልና። የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ በቅርብ ጊዜ ከባቢሎን ይመለሳል የሚሉአችሁን የነቢያቶቻችሁን ቃል አትስሙ።

verses.en: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babel, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
verses.am: እነርሱም አትስሙ፤ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ተገዙ በሕይወትም ኑሩ። ይህችስ ከተማ ስለ ምን ባድማ ትሆናለች?

verses.en: But if they be prophets, and if the word of YAHUAH be with them, let them now make intercession to YAHUAH of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of YAHUAH, and in the house of the king of Yehudah, and at Yerushalayim, go not to Babel.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ነቢያት ቢሆኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእነርሱ ዘንድ ቢገኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም የቀረችው ዕቃ ወደ ባቢሎን እንዳትሄድ ወደ ሠራዊት ጌታ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይማለሉ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም ስለ ቀረችው ዕቃ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yehudah from Yerushalayim to Babel, and all the nobles of Yehudah and Yerushalayim;
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም ስለ ቀረችው ዕቃ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Yea, thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of YAHUAH, and in the house of the king of Yehudah and of Yerushalayim;
verses.am: ወደ ባቢሎን ትወሰዳለች እስከምጐበኛትም ቀን ድረስ በዚያ ትኖራለች፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በዚያን ጊዜም አወጣታለሁ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳታለሁ።

verses.en: They shall be carried to Babel, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith YAHUAH; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yehudah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of YAHUAH, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.am: በዚያም ዓመት በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ በአራተኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ነቢዩ የገባዖን ሰው የዓዙር ልጅ ሐናንያ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በካህናትና በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: Thus speaketh YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babel.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ይናገራል። የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር ሰብሬአለሁ።

verses.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of YAHUAH's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel took away from this place, and carried them to Babel:
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ከዚህች ስፍራ ወደ ባቢሎን የወሰዳትን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ ወደዚህች ስፍራ እመልሳታለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yehudah, with all the captives of Yehudah, that went into Babel, saith YAHUAH: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babel.
verses.am: ወደ ባቢሎንም የሄዱትን የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮአቄምን ልጅ ኢኮንያንንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ ሁሉ ወደዚህች ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ቀንበር እሰብራለሁና።

verses.en: Then the prophet Yirmeyahu said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of YAHUAH,
verses.am: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም በካህናቱና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በቆሙት ሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ለነቢዩ ለሐናንያ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Even the prophet Yirmeyahu said, Amen: YAHUAH do so: YAHUAH perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of YAHUAH's house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babel into this place.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ እንዲህ አለ። አሜን፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያድርግ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ምርኮውንም ሁሉ ከባቢሎን ወደዚህ ስፍራ በመመለስ እግዚአብሔር የተናገርኸውን ትንቢት ይፈጽም።

verses.en: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጆሮህና በሕዝብ ሁሉ ጆሮ የምናገረውን ይህን ቃል ስማ፤

verses.en: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.am: ከጥንት ከእኔና ከአንተ በፊት የነበሩ ነቢያት በብዙ አገርና በታላላቅ መንግሥታት ላይ ስለ ሰልፍና ስለ ክፉ ነገር ስለ ቸነፈርም ትንቢት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that YAHUAH hath truly sent him.
verses.am: ስለ ሰላም የተናገረ ነቢይ፥ የነቢዩ ቃል በሆነ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእውነት የሰደደው ነቢይ እንደ ሆነ ይታወቃል።

verses.en: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Yirmeyahu's neck, and brake it.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ ቀንበሩን ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ አንገት ወስዶ ሰበረው።

verses.en: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Yirmeyahu went his way.
verses.am: ሐናንያም በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እንዲሁ በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ የናቡከደነፆርን ቀንበር ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ አንገት እሰብራለሁ አለ። ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ መንገዱን ሄደ።

verses.en: Then the word of YAHUAH came unto Yirmeyahu the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Yirmeyahu, saying,
verses.am: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ ቀንበሩን ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ አንገት ከሰበረ በኋላ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
verses.am: ሂድ፥ ለሐናንያ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አንተ የእንጨትን ቀንበር ሰብረሃል፥ እኔ ግን በእርሱ ፋንታ የብረትን ቀንበር እሠራለሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር ይገዙለት ዘንድ የብረትን ቀንበር በእነዚህ አሕዛብ ሁሉ አንገት ላይ አድርጌአለሁ፤ እነርሱም ይገዙለታል፥ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ደግሞ ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: Then said the prophet Yirmeyahu unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; YAHUAH hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ ነቢዩን ሐናንያን። ሐናንያ ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ ይህ ሕዝብ በሐሰት እንዲታመን አድርገሃል እንጂ እግዚአብሔር አልላከህም።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against YAHUAH.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ከምድር ላይ እሰድድሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዓመፅን ተናግረሃልና በዚህ ዓመት ትሞታለህ አለው።

verses.en: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ሐናንያ በዚያው ዓመት በሰባተኛው ወር ሞተ።

verses.en: Now these are the words of the letter that Yirmeyahu the prophet sent from Yerushalayim unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Yerushalayim to Babel;
verses.am: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ወደ ተረፉት የምርኮ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ወደ ካህናቱም፥ ወደ ነቢያቱም፥ ናቡከደነፆር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ማርኮ ወዳፈለሰውም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ከኢየሩሳሌም የላከው የደብዳቤው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Yerushalayim;)
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው ንጉሡ ኢኮንያን እናቱም እቴጌይቱ ጃንደረቦቹም የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌምም አለቆች ጠራቢዎችና ብረት ሠራተኞችም ከኢየሩሳሌም ከወው በኋላ ነው።

verses.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Yehudah sent unto Babel to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel) saying,
verses.am: ኤርምያስ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወደ ናቡከደነፆር ወደ ባቢሎን በላካቸው በሳፋን ልጅ በኤልዓሣና በኬልቅያስ ልጅ በገማርያ እጅ ደብዳቤውን እንዲህ ሲል ላከው።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Yerushalayim unto Babel;
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን ላስማረክኋቸው ምርኮኞች ሁሉ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.am: ቤት ሠርታችሁ ተቀመጡ፥ አታክልትም ተክላችሁ ፍሬዋን ብሉ፤

verses.en: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.am: ተጋቡ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ውለዱ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁንም አጋቡ፥ እነርሱም ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን ልጆች ይውለዱ፤ ከዚያም ተባዙ ጥቂቶችም አትሁኑ።

verses.en: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto YAHUAH for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.am: በእርስዋ ሰላም ሰላም ይሆንላችኋልና ወደ እርስዋ ላስማርክኋችሁ ከተማ ሰላምን ፈልጉ፥ ስለ እርስዋም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልዩ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በመካከላችሁ ያሉት ነቢያቶቻችሁና ምዋርተኞቻችሁ አያታልሉአችሁ፥ እናንተም የምታልሙትን ሕልም አትስሙ።

verses.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ይናገሩላችኋልና፤ እኔም አልላክኋቸውም።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babel I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰባው ዓመት በባቢሎን በተፈጸመ ጊዜ እጐበኛችኋለሁ፥ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳችሁ ዘንድ መልካሚቱን ቃሌን እፈጽምላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith YAHUAH, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.am: ለእናንተ የማስባትን አሳብ እኔ አውቃለሁ፤ ፍጻሜና ተስፋ እሰጣችሁ ዘንድ የሰላም አሳብ ነው እንጂ የክፉ ነገር አይደለም።

verses.en: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.am: እናንተም ትጠሩኛለችሁ፥ ሄዳችሁም ወደ እኔ ትጸልያላችሁ፥ እኔም እሰማችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.am: እናንተ ትሹኛላችሁ፥ በፍጹም ልባችሁም ከሻችሁኝ ታገኙኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And I will be found of you, saith YAHUAH: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith YAHUAH; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.am: ከእናንተም ዘንድ እገኛለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ምርኮአችሁንም እመልሳለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም ሁሉ ዘንድ እናንተንም ካሳደድሁበት ስፍራ ሁሉ እሰበስባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እናንተንም ለምርኮ ወዳፈለስሁበት ስፍራ እመልሳችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Because ye have said, YAHUAH hath raised us up prophets in Babel;
verses.am: እናንተም። እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ነቢያትን አስነሥቶልናል ብላችኋልና፤

verses.en: Know that thus saith YAHUAH of the king that sitteth upon the throne of Dawid, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በዳዊት ዙፋን ስለ ተቀመጠ ንጉሥ ከእናንተም ጋር ስላልተማረኩት ወንድሞቻችሁ፥ በዚህች ከተማ ስለሚኖሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሰይፍንና ራብን ቸነፈርንም እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፥ ከክፋቱም የተነሣ ይበላ ዘንድ እንደማይቻል እንደ ክፉ በለስ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.am: በሰይፍም በራብም በቸነፈርም አሳዳድዳቸዋለሁ፥ ባሳደድሁባቸውም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ዘንድ ለጥላቻና ለመደነቂያ ለማፍዋጫም ለመሰደቢያም እንዲሆኑ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ዘንድ ለመበተን አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith YAHUAH, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው ቃሌን ስላልሰሙ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ወደ እነርሱ ሰድጃለሁና፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Hear ye therefore the word of YAHUAH, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Yerushalayim to Babel:
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ባቢሎን የሰደድኋችሁ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በስሜ ሐሰተኛ ትንቢትን ስለሚናገሩላችሁ ስለ ቆላያ ልጅ ስለ አክዓብና ስለ መዕሤያ ልጅ ስለ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ በዓይኖቻችሁም ፊት ይገድላቸዋል።

verses.en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Yehudah which are in Babel, saying, YAHUAH make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babel roasted in the fire;
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የተነሣ በባቢሎን ያሉ የይሁዳ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ። የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በእሳት እንደ ጠበሳቸው እንደ ሴዴቅያስና እንደ አክዓብ እግዚአብሔር ያድርግህ የምትባል እርግማንን ያነሣሉ፤ እኔም አውቃለሁ ምስክርም ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Because they have committed villany in Yisra'el, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ዘንድ ስንፍና አድርገዋልና፥ ከባልንጀሮቻቸውም ሚስቶች ጋር አመንዝረዋልና፥ ያላዘዝኋቸውንም ቃል በስሜ በሐሰት ተናግረዋልና።

verses.en: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.am: ለኔሔላማዊው ለሸማያ እንዲህ በል።

verses.en: Thus speaketh YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Yerushalayim, and to Tsephanyah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በኢየሩሳሌም ወዳለው ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ካህኑም ወደ መዕሤያ ልጅ ወደ ሶፎንያስ፥ ወደ ካህናቱም ሁሉ ደብዳቤዎችን በስምህ እንዲህ ስትል ልከሃል።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of YAHUAH, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.am: እያበደ ትንቢት የሚናገርን ሰው ሁሉ በእግር ግንድና በዛንጅር ታኖረው ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አለቃ እንድትሆን እግዚአብሔር በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ፋንታ ካህን አድርጎሃል።

verses.en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Yirmeyahu of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
verses.am: አሁንስ ትንቢት ተናጋሪውን የዓናቶቱን ሰው ኤርምያስን ስለ ምን አትዘልፈውም?

verses.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babel, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.am: እርሱ። ምርኮው የረዘመው ነውና ቤት ሠርታችሁ ተቀመጡ፥ አታክልትንም ተክላችሁ ፍሬዋን ብሉ ብሎ ወደ እኛ ወደ ባቢሎን ልኮአልና።

verses.en: And Tsephanyah the priest read this letter in the ears of Yirmeyahu the prophet.
verses.am: ካህኑም ሶፎንያስ ይህን ደብዳቤ በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ ጆሮ አነበበው።

verses.en: Then came the word of YAHUAH unto Yirmeyahu, saying,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith YAHUAH concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኔሔላማዊው ስለ ሸማያ እንዲህ ይላል ብለህ ወደ ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ላክ። እኔ ሳልልከው ሸማያ ትንቢት ተናግሮላችኋልና፥ በሐሰትም እንድትታመኑ አድርጎአችኋልና፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith YAHUAH; because he hath taught rebellion against YAHUAH.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ኔሔላማዊውን ሸማያንና ዘሩን እቀጣለሁ፤ እኔም የማደርግላችሁን መልካሙን ነገር የሚያይ ሰው በመካከላችሁ አይኖርላችሁም

verses.en: The word that came to Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus speaketh YAHUAH of Yisra'el, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የነገርሁህን ቃል ሁሉ በመጽሐፍ ጻፍ።

verses.en: For, lo, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Yisra'el and Yehudah, saith YAHUAH: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የሕዝቤን የእስራኤልንና የይሁዳን ምርኮ የምመልስባት ዘመን ይመጣልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ እነርሱም ይገዙአታል።

verses.en: And these are the words that YAHUAH spake concerning Yisra'el and concerning Yehudah.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤልና ስለ ይሁዳ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። የሚያስፈራ ድምፅ ሰምተናል፤ የፍርሃት ነው እንጂ የሰላም አይደለም።

verses.en: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.am: ጠይቁ፥ ወንድ ይወልድ እንደ ሆነ ተመልከቱ፤ ስለ ምን ሰው ሁሉ እንደ ወላድ እጁን በወገቡ ላይ አድርጎ ፊቱም ሁሉ ወደ ጥቁረት ተለውጦ አየሁ?

verses.en: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Ya'aqob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.am: ወዮ! ያ ቀን ታላቅ ነውና፥ እርሱንም የሚመስል የለምና፤ ያ የያዕቆብ መከራ ዘመን ነው፥ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ይድናል።

verses.en: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith YAHUAH of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ ቀንበርን ከአንገትህ እሰብራለሁ፥ እስራትህንም እበጥሳለሁ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ለሌላ አትገዛም፤

verses.en: But they shall serve YAHUAH their YAHUAH, and Dawid their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.am: ለአምላካቸው ለእግዚአብሔርም ለማስነሣላቸው ለንጉሣቸው ለዳዊትም ይገዛሉ እንጂ ሌሎች አሕዛብ እንደ ገና አይገዙአቸውም።

verses.en: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Ya'aqob, saith YAHUAH; neither be dismayed, O Yisra'el: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Ya'aqob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አንተን ከሩቅ ዘርህንም ከምርኮ አገር አድናለሁና ባሪያዬ ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ አንተም እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አትደንግጥ፤ ያዕቆብም ይመለሳል ያርፍማል ተዘልሎም ይቀመጣል፤ ማንም አያስፈራውም።

verses.en: For I am with thee, saith YAHUAH, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
verses.am: አድንህ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ አንተንም የበተንሁባቸውን አሕዛብን ሁሉ ፈጽሜ አጠፋለሁ፥ አንተን ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋህም፤ በመጠን እቀጣሃለሁ፥ ያለ ቅጣትም ከቶ አልተውህም።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስብራትህ የማይፈወስ ቍስልህም ክፉ ነው።

verses.en: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.am: ትጠገን ዘንድ ክርክርህን የሚፈርድልህ የለም፥ ቍስልህንም የሚፈውስ መድኃኒት የለህም።

verses.en: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
verses.am: ውሽሞችህ ሁሉ ረስተውሃል አይፈልጉህምም፤ በደልህ ታላቅ ስለሆነ ኃጢአትህም ስለ በዛ፥ በጠላት ማቍሰልና በጨካኝ ቅጣት አቍስዬሃለሁና።

verses.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.am: ሕመምህ የማይፈወስ ሆኖአልና ስለ ስብራትህ ለምን ትጮኻለህ? በደልህ ታላቅ ስለሆነ ኃጢአትህም ስለ በዛ፥ ይህን አድርጌብሃለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሚውጡህ ሁሉ ይዋጣሉ፥ ጠላቶችህም ሁላቸው ይማረካሉ፤ የዘረፉህም ይዘረፋሉ፥ የበዘበዙህንም ሁሉ ለመበዝበዝ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith YAHUAH; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.am: እኔ ጤናህን እመልስልሃለሁ ቍስልህንም እፈውሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ማንም የማይሻት፥ የተጣለች ጽዮን ብለው ጠርተውሻልና።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Ya'aqob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የያዕቆብን ድንኳን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ለማደሪያውም እራራለሁ፤ ከተማይቱም በጉብታዋ ላይ ትሠራለች፥ አዳራሹም እንደ ዱሮው የሰው መኖሪያ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ዘንድ የምስጋናና የዘፋኞች ድምፅ ይወጣል፤ እኔም አበዛቸዋለሁ አያንሱምም፥ እኔም አከብራቸዋለሁ ታናሽም አይሆኑም።

verses.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውም እንደ ቀድሞ ይሆናሉ፥ ማኅበራቸውም በፊቴ ጸንቶ ይኖራል፤ የሚያስጨንቋቸውንም ሁሉ እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: አለቃቸው ከእነርሱ ውስጥ ይሆናል፥ ገዥአቸውም ከመካከላቸው ይወጣል፤ እኔ አቀርበዋለሁ እርሱም ይቀርባል፤ ይህስ ባይሆን ወደ እኔ ለመቅረብ የሚደፍር ማን ነው? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተም ሕዝብ ትሆኑኛላችሁ እኔም አምላክ እሆናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, the whirlwind of YAHUAH goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥ እርሱም ቍጣው፥ የሚያገለባብጥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ወጥቶአል፤ የዓመፀኞችንም ራስ ይገለባብጣል።

verses.en: The fierce anger of YAHUAH shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ የልቡን አሳብ ሠርቶ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ አይመለስም በኋለኛው ዘመን ታስተውሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: At the same time, saith YAHUAH, will I be YAHUAH of all the families of Yisra'el, and they shall be my people.
verses.am: በዚያን ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ለእስራኤል ወገኖች ሁሉ አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Yisra'el, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስራኤል ማረፊያ ሊሻ በሄደ ጊዜ ከሰይፍ የተረፈው ሕዝብ በምድረ በዳ ሞገስ አገኘ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከሩቅ ተገለጠልኝ እንዲህም አለኝ። በዘላለም ፍቅር ወድጄሻለሁ፤ ስለዚህ በቸርነት ሳብሁሽ።

verses.en: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Yisra'el: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ድንግል ሆይ፥ እንደ ገና እሠራሻለሁ አንቺም ትሠሪያለሽ፤ እንደ ገናም ከበሮሽን አንሥተሽ ከዘፋኞች ጋር ወደ ዘፈን ትወጫለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
verses.am: እንደ ገናም በሰማርያ ተራሮች ላይ የወይን ቦታዎችን ትተክሊአለሽ፤ አትክልተኞች ይተክላሉ በፍሬውም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: በኤፍሬምም ተራሮች ላይ ያሉ ጠባቆች። ተነሡ፥ ወደ ጽዮን ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንውጣ ብለው የሚጮኹበት ቀን ይመጣልና።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH; Sing with gladness for Ya'aqob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O YAHUAH, save thy people, the remnant of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ስለ ያዕቆብ ደስ ይበላችሁ ስለ አሕዛብም አለቆች እልል በሉ፤ አውሩ፥ አመስግኑ። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን የእስራኤልን ቅሬታ አድኖአል በሉ።

verses.en: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን አገር አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከምድርም ዳርቻ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ በመካከላቸውም ዕውሩና አንካሳው ያረገዘችና የወለደችም በአንድነት፤ ታላቅ ጉባኤ ሆነው ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Yisra'el, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.am: በልቅሶ ወጡ እኔም በማጽናናት አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ በወንዝ ዳር በቅን መንገድ አስኬዳቸዋለሁ፥ በእርሱም አይሰናከሉም፤ እኔ ለእስራኤል አባት ነኝና፥ ኤፍሬምም በኵሬ ነውና።

verses.en: Hear the word of YAHUAH, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yisra'el will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፥ በሩቅም ላሉ ደሴቶች አውሩና። እስራኤልን የበተነ እርሱ ይሰበስበዋል፥ እረኛም መንጋውን እንደሚጠብቅ ይጠብቀዋል በሉ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath redeemed Ya'aqob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ተቤዥቶታል፥ ከበረቱበትም እጅ አድኖታል።

verses.en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of YAHUAH, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.am: ይመጣሉ በጽዮንም ተራራ እልል ይላሉ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በጎነት፥ ወደ እህልና ወደ ወይን ጠጅ ወደ ዘይትም፥ ወደ በጎችና ወደ ላሞች ይሰበሰባሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውም እንደ ረካች ገነት ትሆናለች፥ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አያዝኑም።

verses.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ድንግሊቱ በዘፈን ደስ ይላታል፥ ጐበዛዝቱና ሽማግሌዎቹም በአንድ ላይ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ልቅሶአቸውንም ወደ ደስታ እመልሳለሁ፥ አጽናናቸውማለሁ፥ ከኅዘናቸውም ደስ አሰኛቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: የካህናቱንም ነፍስ በብዛት አረካታለሁ ሕዝቤም በጎነቴን ይጠግባል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የዋይታና የመራራ ልቅሶ ድምፅ በራማ ተሰማ፤ ራሔል ስለ ልጆችዋ አለቀሰች፤ የሉምና ስለ ልጆችዋ መጽናናትን እንቢ አለች።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith YAHUAH; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ድምፅሽን ከልቅሶ ዓይንሽንም ከእንባ ከልክዪ፤ ለሥራሽ ዋጋ ይሆናልና፥ ከጠላትም ምድር ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: And there is hope in thine end, saith YAHUAH, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
verses.am: ለፍጻሜሽም ተስፋ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ልጆችሽም ወደ ዳርቻቸው ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art YAHUAH my YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም። ቀጣኸኝ እኔም እንዳልተገራ ወይፈን ተቀጣሁ፤ አንተ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ነህና መልሰኝ እኔም እመለሳለሁ።

verses.en: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.am: ከተመለስሁ በኋላ ተጸጸትሁ፥ ከተገሠጽሁም በኋላ ጭኔን ጸፋሁ፤ የብላቴንነቴንም ስድብ ተሸክሜአለሁና አፈርሁ፥ ተዋረድሁም ብሎ ሲያለቅስ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእውነት ኤፍሬም ለእኔ የከበረ ልጅ ነውን? ወይስ የተወደደ ሕፃን ነውን? በእርሱ ላይ በተናገርሁ ቍጥር አስበዋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ አንጀቴ ታወከችለት ርኅራኄም እራራለታለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Yisra'el, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.am: ለራስሽ የመንገድ ምልክት አድርጊ፥ መንገድንም የሚመሩ ዓምዶችን ትከዪ፥ ልብሽንም ወደ ሄድሽበት መንገድ ወደ ጥርጊያው አቅኚ፤ አንቺ የእስራኤል ድንግል ሆይ፥ ተመለሺ፥ ወደ እነዚህም ወደ ከተሞችሽ ተመለሺ።

verses.en: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for YAHUAH hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.am: አንቺ ከዳተኛ ልጅ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ትቅበዘበዣለሽ? እግዚአብሔር በምድር ላይ አዲስ ነገር ፈጥሮአልና ሴት ወንድን ትከብባለች።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Yehudah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; YAHUAH bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠርዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ምርኮአቸውን በመለስሁ ጊዜ በይሁዳ አገር በከተሞችዋ። የጽድቅ ማደሪያ ሆይ፥ የቅድስና ተራራ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ የሚልን ነገር እንደ ገና ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: And there shall dwell in Yehudah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በአገሩ ሁሉ ከገበሬዎችና መንጋን ይዘው ከሚዞሩ ጋር የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ይገኛሉ።

verses.en: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.am: የደከመችውን ነፍስ አርክቻለሁና፥ ያዘነችውንም ነፍስ ሁሉ አጥግቤአለሁና።

verses.en: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ነቃሁ ተመለከትሁም፥ እንቅልፌም ጣፋጭ ሆነልኝ።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that I will sow the house of Yisra'el and the house of Yehudah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ቤትና የይሁዳን ቤት በሰው ዘርና በእንስሳ ዘር የምዘራበት ዘመን፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ አፈርሳቸውና ክፉ አድርግባቸው ዘንድ እንደ ተጋሁባቸው፥ እንዲሁ እሠራቸውና እተክላቸው ዘንድ እተጋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
verses.am: በዚያ ዘመን ሰው ዳግመኛ እንዲህ አይልም። አባቶች ጨርቋ የወይን ፍሬ በሉ፥ የልጆችም ጥርሶች ጠረሱ፤

verses.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰው ሁሉ በገዛ በደሉ ይሞታል፤ መራራውን የወይን ፍሬ የሚበላ ሁሉ ጥርሶቹ ይጠርሳሉ።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Yisra'el, and with the house of Yehudah:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ቃል ኪዳን የምገባበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Mitsrayim; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith YAHUAH:
verses.am: ከግብጽ አገር አወጣቸው ዘንድ እጃቸውን በያዝሁበት ቀን ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር እንደ ገባሁት ያለ ቃል ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ አልጸኑምና፥ እኔም ቸል አልኋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yisra'el; After those days, saith YAHUAH, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their YAHUAH, and they shall be my people.
verses.am: ከእነዚያ ወራት በኋላ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጋር የምገባው ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነውና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ሕጌን በልቡናቸው አኖራለሁ፥ በልባቸውም እጽፈዋለሁ፤ እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል።

verses.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know YAHUAH: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith YAHUAH: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱ ሰው ባልንጀራውን፥ እያንዳንዱም ወንድሙን። እግዚአብሔርን እወቅ ብሎ አያስተምርም፤ ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ያውቁኛልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። በደላቸውን እምራቸዋለሁና፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አላስብምና።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; YAHUAH of hosts is his name:
verses.am: ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ የሚባል፥ ፀሐይን በቀን የጨረቃንና የከዋክብትን ሥርዓት በሌሊት ብርሃን አድርጎ የሚሰጥ፥ እንዲተምሙም የባሕርን ሞገዶች የሚያናውጥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith YAHUAH, then the seed of Yisra'el also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.am: ይህ ሕግ ከፊቴ ቢወገድ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ደግሞ የእስራኤል ዘር በፊቴ ሕዝብ እንዳይሆን ለዘላለም ይቀራል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Yisra'el for all that they have done, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰማይ በላይ ቢከነዳ፥ የምድርም መሠረት በታች ቢመረመር፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ስላደረጉት ነገር ሁሉ የእስራኤልን ዘር ሁሉ እጥላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that the city shall be built to YAHUAH from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.am: ከሐናንኤል ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ ከተማ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሠራበት ዘመን፥ እነሆ፥ ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
verses.am: የተለካበትም ገመድ ወደ ጋሬብ ኮረብታ በቀጥታ ወደ ፊት ይሄዳል፥ ወደ ጎዓም ይዞራል።

verses.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto YAHUAH; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.am: የሬሳም ሸለቆ ሁሉ የአመድም እርሻ ሁሉ እስከ ቄድሮን ወንዝ ድረስ በምሥራቅ በኩል እስካለው እስከ ፈረሰ በር ማዕዘን ድረስ ለእግዚአብሄር የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ ለዘላለም አይነቀልም አይፈርስምም።

verses.en: The word that came to Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Yehudah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ በአሥረኛው ዓመት፥ በናቡክደነፆር በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: For then the king of Babel's army besieged Yerushalayim: and Yirmeyahu the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Yehudah's house.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምን ከብቦ ነበር፤ ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ቤት በነበረው በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ነበር።

verses.en: For Zedekiah king of Yehudah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babel, and he shall take it;
verses.am: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ እንዲህ ብሎ አስጠብቆት ነበርና። ስለ ምን እንዲህ ብለህ ትንቢት ትናገራለህ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ እርሱም ይይዛታል፤

verses.en: And Zedekiah king of Yehudah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babel, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ በእውነት በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አልፎ ይሰጣል፥ አፍ ለአፍም ይናገረዋል፥ ዓይኑም ዓይኑን ያያል እንጂ ከከለዳውያን እጅ አያመልጥም፤

verses.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babel, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith YAHUAH: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.
verses.am: እርሱም ሴዴቅያስን ወደ ባቢሎን ያፈልሰዋል፥ እኔም እስክጐበኘው ድረስ በዚያ ይኖራል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከከላዳውያን ጋር ብትዋጉ ምንም አትረቡም።

verses.en: And Yirmeyahu said, The word of YAHUAH came unto me, saying,
verses.am: ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አለ። የእግዚአብሄር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የአጐትህ የሰሎም ልጅ አናምኤል ወደ አንተ መጥቶ። ትገዛው ዘንድ መቤዠቱ የአንተ ነውና በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን ግዛ ይልሃል።

verses.en: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of YAHUAH, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል የአጐቴ ልጅ አናምኤል እኔ ወዳለሁበት ወደ ግዞቱ ቤት አደባባይ መጥቶ። በብንያም አገር በዓናቶት ያለውን እርሻዬን፥ እባክህ፥ ግዛ፤ ርስቱ የአንተ ነውና፥ መቤዠቱም የአንተ ነውና፤ ለአንተ ግዛው አለኝ። ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ሆነ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.am: በዓናቶትም ያለውን እርሻ ከአጐቴ ልጅ ከአናምኤል ገዛሁ፥ አሥራ ሰባት ሰቅል ብርም መዘንሁለት።

verses.en: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
verses.am: በውሉም ወረቀት ላይ ፈረምሁ አተምሁትም፥ ምስክሮችንም ጠርቼ ብሩን በሚዛን መዘንሁለት።

verses.en: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
verses.am: የታተመውንና የተከፈተውን የውል ወረቀት ወሰድሁ፤

verses.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruk the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Yehudim that sat in the court of the prison.
verses.am: የአጐቴም ልጅ አናምኤል፥ የውሉንም ወረቀት የፈረሙ ምስክሮች፥ በግዞትም ቤት አደባባይ የተቀመጡ አይሁድ ሁሉ እያዩ የውሉን ወረቀት ለመሕሤያ ልጅ ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክ ሰጠሁት።

verses.en: And I charged Baruk before them, saying,
verses.am: በፊታቸውም እንዲህ ብዬ ባሮክን አዘዝሁት።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ብዙ ቀን ይጠበቁ ዘንድ የታተመውንና የተከፈተውን ይህን የውል ወረከት ወስደህ በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ አኑራቸው።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ሰዎች በዚህች ምድር ቤትንና እርሻን የወይን ቦታንም እንደ ገና ይገዛሉ።

verses.en: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruk the son of Neriah, I prayed unto YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: ለኔርያ ልጅ ለባሮክም የውሉን ወረቀት ከሰጠሁት በኋላ፥ እንዲህ ብዬ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለይሁ።

verses.en: Ah YAHUAH! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ አንተ ሰማይንና ምድርን በታላቅ ኃይልህና በተዘረጋች ክንድህ ፈጥረሃል፥ ከአንተም የሚያቅት ነገር የለም።

verses.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty YAHUAH, YAHUAH of hosts, is his name,
verses.am: ለብዙ ሺህ ምሕረት ታደርጋለህ፥ የአባቶችንም በደል ከእነርሱ በኋላ በልጆቻቸው ብብት ትመልሳለህ፤ ስምህ ታላቅና ኃያል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
verses.am: በምክር ታላቅ በሥራም ብርቱ ነህ፤ ለሁሉም እንደ መንገዱና እንደ ሥራው ፍሬ ትሰጥ ዘንድ ዓይኖችህ በአዳም ልጆች መንገድ ሁሉ ተገልጠዋል።

verses.en: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Mitsrayim, even unto this day, and in Yisra'el, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
verses.am: እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ምልክትንና ድንቅን ነገር በግብጽ ምድር ደግሞም በእስራኤልና በሌሎች ሰዎች መካከል አድርገሃል፥ እንደ ዛሬም ለአንተ ስም አድርገሃል።

verses.en: And hast brought forth thy people Yisra'el out of the land of Mitsrayim with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
verses.am: በምልክትና በድንቅ ነገር፥ በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋች ክንድ በታላቅም ግርማ ሕዝብህን እስራኤልን ከግብጽ ምድር አወጣህ።

verses.en: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.am: ትሰጣቸውም ዘንድ ለአባቶቻቸው የማልህላቸውን ምድር፥ ወተትና ማርንም የምታፈስሰውን ምድር፥ ሰጠሃቸው፤

verses.en: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
verses.am: እነርሱም ገብተው ወረሱአት፤ ነገር ግን ቃልህን አልሰሙም በሕግህም አልሄዱም፥ ያደረርም ዘንድ ካዘዝሃቸው ሁሉ ምንም አላደረጉም፤ ስለዚህ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣህባቸው።

verses.en: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
verses.am: እነሆ የአፈር ድልድል፥ ሊይዙአትም እስከ ከተማይቱ ድረስ ቀርበዋል፤ ከሰይፍና ከራብ ከቸነፈርም የተነሣ ከተማይቱ ለሚዋጉአት ለከለዳውያን እጅ ተሰጥታለች፥ የተናገርኸውም ሆኖአል፤ እነሆም፥ አንተ ታየዋለህ።

verses.en: And thou hast said unto me, O YAHUAH, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.am: አንተም፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ። እርሻውን በብር ግዛ ምስክሮችንም ጥራ አልኸኝ፤ ከተማይቱ ግን ለከለዳውያን እጅ ተሰጥታለች።

verses.en: Then came the word of YAHUAH unto Yirmeyahu, saying,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Behold, I am YAHUAH, YAHUAH of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ የሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel, and he shall take it:
verses.am: በውኑ እኔን የሚያቅተኝ ነገር አለን? ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ ለከለዳውያን እጅና ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ለናቡከደነፆር እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ እርሱም ይይዛታል።

verses.en: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other elohim, to provoke me to anger.
verses.am: ይህችን ከተማ የሚወጉ ከለዳውያን መጥተው በእሳት ያነድዱአታል፥ ያስቈጡኝም ዘንድ በሰገነታቸው ላይ ለበኣል ካጠኑባቸው፥ ለሌሎችም አማልክት የመጠጥን KWrባን ካፈሰሱባቸው ቤቶች ጋር ያቃጥሉአታል።

verses.en: For the children of Yisra'el and the children of Yehudah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Yisra'el have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች ከታናሽነታቸው ጀምሮ በፊቴ ክፉ ነገርን ብቻ አድርገዋልና፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እኔን በእጃቸው ሥራ ከማስቈጣት በቀር ሌላ ሥራ አላደረጉምና።

verses.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
verses.am: ከፊቴ አስወግዳት ዘንድ ይህች ከተማ ከሠሩአት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቍጣዬንና መዓቴን ለማነሣሣት ሆናለችና፤

verses.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Yisra'el and of the children of Yehudah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Yehudah, and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ይህም እኔን ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ፥ እነርሱና ነገሥታቶቻቸው አለቆቻቸውም ካህናቶቻቸውም ነቢያቶቻቸውም የይሁዳም ሰዎች በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚንኖሩ፥ ስላደረጉት ስለ እስራኤል ልጆችና ስለ ይሁዳ ልጆች ክፋት ሁሉ ነው።

verses.en: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.am: ፊታቸውንም ሳይሆን ጀርባቸውን ወደ እኔ መለሱ፤ እኔም በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ሳሰተምራቸው ተግሣጽን ይቀበሉ ዘንድ አልሰሙም።

verses.en: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.am: ያረክሱትም ዘንድ ስሜ በተጠራበት ቤት ውስጥ ርkWsvታቸውን አኖሩ።

verses.en: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Yehudah to sin.
verses.am: ይሁዳን ወደ ኃጢአት እንዲያገቡት፥ ይህንን ርkWsvት ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ እኔ ያላዘዝሁትንና በልቤ ያላሰብሁትን ነገር፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለሞሎክ በእሳት ያሳልፉ ዘንድ በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ያሉትን የበኣልን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች ሠሩ።

verses.en: And now therefore thus saith YAHUAH, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babel by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር አንተ ስለ እርስዋ። በሰይፍና በራብ በቸነፈርም ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ ተሰጥታለች ስለምትላት ከተማ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በቍጣዬና በመዓቴ በታላቅም መቅሠፍቴ እነርሱን ካሳደድሁባት አገር ሁሉ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፥ ወደዚህም ስፍራ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ ተዘልለውም እንዲኖሩ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: And they shall be my people, and I will be their YAHUAH:
verses.am: እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል እኔም አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
verses.am: ለእነርሱም ከእነርሱም በኋላ ለልጆቻቸው መልካም ይሆንላቸው ዘንድ ለዘላለም እንዲፈሩኝ አንድ ልብና አንድ መንገድ እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም ከማደርገው በጎነት አልመለስም ስል፥ ከእነርሱ ጋር የዘላለምን ቃል ኪዳን እገባለሁ፤ ከእኔም ዘንድ ፈቀቅ እንዳይሉ መፈራቴን በልባቸው ውስጥ አኖራለሁ።

verses.en: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም መልካምን በማድረግ ደስ ይለኛል በእውነትም በፍጹም ልቤና በፍጹም ነፍሴ በዚህች ምድር እተክላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ይህን እጅግ ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ እንዳመጣሁ፥ እንዲሁ የተናገርሁላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ አመጣላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.am: እናንተም። ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንሰሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት፥ ለከለዳውያንም እጅ ተሰጥታለች በምትሉአት ምድር እርሻን ይገዛሉ።

verses.en: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Yerushalayim, and in the cities of Yehudah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ምርኮኞቻቸውንም እመልሳለሁና በብንያም አገር በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ ስፍራዎች፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች በደጋውም ባሉ ከተሞች በቈላውም ባሉ ከተሞች በደቡብም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ ሰዎች እርሻውን በብር ይገዛሉ በውሉም ወረቀት ፈርመው ያትማሉ ምስክሮችንም ይጠራሉ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of YAHUAH came unto Yirmeyahu the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.am: ኤርምያስ ገና በግዞት ቤት አደባባይ ታስሮ ሳለ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁለተኛ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሲል መጣለት።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH the maker thereof, YAHUAH that formed it, to establish it; YAHUAH is his name;
verses.am: ስሙ እግዚአብሔር የሆነ፥ ያደረገው እግዚአብሔር፥ ያጸናውም ዘንድ የሠራው እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ጩኽ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ፤ አንተም የማታውቀውን ታላቅና ኃይለኛ ነገርን አሳይሃለሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Yehudah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሄር ለአፈር ድልድልና ለምሽግ ስለ ፈረሱ ስለዚህች ከተማ ቤቶች፥ ስለ ይሁዳም ነገሥታት ቤቶች እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
verses.am: ከለዳውያን ለመዋጋት መጥተዋል፤ ነገር ግን በKWTaዬና በመዓቴ በገደልኋቸው ሰዎች ሬሳዎች ሊሞሉአቸው ነው፥ ስለ ክፋታቸው ሁሉ ፊቴን ከዚህች ከተማ ሰውሬአለሁና።

verses.en: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ፈውስንና መድኃኒትን አመጣላታለሁ፥ እፈውሳቸውማለሁ፤ የሰላምንና የእውነትን ብዛት እገልጥላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will cause the captivity of Yehudah and the captivity of Yisra'el to return, and will build them, as at the first.
verses.am: የይሁዳን ምርኮና የእስራኤልንም ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ቀድሞም እንደ ነበሩ አድርጌ እሠራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
verses.am: እኔንም ከበደሉበት ኃጢአት ሁሉ አነጻቸዋለሁ እኔንም የበደሉኝን ያመፀብኝንም ኃጢአታቸውን ሁሉ ይቅር እላለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
verses.am: ይህችም ከተማ እኔ የምሠራላቸውን በጎነት ሁሉ በሚሰሙ እኔም ስላመጣሁላቸው በጎነትና ሰላም ሁሉ በሚፈሩና በሚደነግጡ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ለደስታ ስም ለምስጋናም ለክብርም ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Yehudah, and in the streets of Yerushalayim, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲ ይላል። እናንተ። ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ያለች ባድማ ናት በምትሉአት በዚህች ስፍራ፥ የሚቀመጥባቸው በሌላ፥ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ባድማ በሆኑ በይሁዳ ከተሞችና በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ፥

verses.en: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise YAHUAH of hosts: for YAHUAH is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of YAHUAH. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሐሤት ድምፅና የደስታ ድምፅ፥ የወንድ ሙሽራ ድምፅና የሴት ሙሽራ ድምፅ። እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና የሠራዊትን ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚሉ ድምፅ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት የሚያመጡት ድምፅ እንደ ገና ይሰማል። የምድርን ምርኮ ቀድሞ እንደ ነበረ አድርጌ እመልሳለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ባድማ ሆኖ፥ ያለ ሰውና ያለ እንስሳ ባለው በዚህ ስፍራ በከተሞችም ሁሉ መንጎቻቸውን የሚያሳርፉት የእረኞች መኖሪያ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Yerushalayim, and in the cities of Yehudah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በደጋው ላይ ባሉ ከተሞች በቈላውም ባሉ ከተሞች በደቡብም ባሉ ከተሞች፥ በብንያምም አገር በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ባሉ ስፍራዎች፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች መንጎቹ በተቈጣጣሪው እጅ እንደ ገና ያልፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Yisra'el and to the house of Yehudah.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ስለ እስራኤል ቤትና ስለ ይሁዳ ቤት የተናገርሁትን መልካም ቃል የምፈጽምበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto Dawid; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን በዚያም ጊዜ ለዳዊት የጽድቅን ቍጥቋጥ አበቅልለታለሁ፤ እርሱም ፍርድንና ጽድቅን በምድር ያደርጋል።

verses.en: In those days shall Yehudah be saved, and Yerushalayim shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, YAHUAH our righteousness.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ይሁዳ ይድናል ኢየሩሳሌምም ተዘልላ ትቀመጣለች፤ የምትጠራበትም ስም። እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችን ተብሎ ነው።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH; Dawid shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Yisra'el;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በእስራኤል ቤት ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጥ ሰው ከዳዊት ዘንድ አይታጣም፤

verses.en: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ የእህሉንም ቍርባን የሚያቃጥል ሁልጊዜም የሚሠዋ ሰው ከሌዋውያን ካህናት ዘንድ በእኔ ፊት አይታጣም።

verses.en: And the word of YAHUAH came unto Yirmeyahu, saying,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ቀንና ሌሊት በወራቱ እንዳይሆን የቀን ቃል ኪዳኔንና የሌሊት ቃል ኪዳኔን ማፍረስ ብትችሉ፥

verses.en: Then may also my covenant be broken with Dawid my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
verses.am: በዙፋኑ ላይ የሚነግሥ ልጅ እንዳይሆንለት ከባሪዬ ከዳዊት ጋር፥ ከአገልጋዮቼም ከሌዋውያን ካህናት ጋር ያለው ቃል ኪዳኔ ደግሞ ይፈርሳል።

verses.en: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of Dawid my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
verses.am: የሰማይን ሠራዊት መቍጠር የባሕርንም አሸዋ መስፈር እንደማይቻል፥ እንዲሁ የባሪያዬን የዳዊትን ዘርና የሚያገለግሉኝን ሌዋውያንን አበዛለሁ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of YAHUAH came to Yirmeyahu, saying,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which YAHUAH hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ። እግዚአብሔር የመረጣቸውን ሁለቱን ወገን ጥሎአቸዋል ያለውን ነገር አትመለከትምን? እንዲሁ በፊታቸው ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ሕዝብ እንዳይሆን ሕዝቤን አቃልለዋል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የቀንና የሌሊት ቃል ኪዳኔን የሰማይንና የምድርንም ሥርዓት ያላጸናሁ እንደሆነ፥

verses.en: Then will I cast away the seed of Ya'aqob, and Dawid my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Yitschaq, and Ya'aqob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
verses.am: እኔም ደግሞ በአብርሃምና በይስሐቅ በያዕቆብም ዘር ላይ ገዦች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ከዘሩ እንዳልወስድ፥ የያዕቆብንና የባሪያዬን የዳዊትን ዘር እጥላለሁ፤ ምርኮአቸውን እመልሳለሁና፥ እምራቸውማለሁና።

verses.en: The word which came unto Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babel, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Yerushalayim, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ከእጁም ግዛት በታች ያሉ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ኢየሩሳሌምንና ከተሞችዋን ሁሉ ይወጉ በነበረ ጊዜ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Yehudah, and tell him, Thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babel, and he shall burn it with fire:
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሂድ ለይሁዳም ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ ተናገር እንዲህም በለው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ይህችን ከተማ በባቢሎን ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፥ በእሳትም ያቃጥላታል፤

verses.en: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babel, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babel.
verses.am: አንተም በእርግጥ ትያዛለህ በእጅም አልፈህ ትሰጣለህ እንጂ ከእጁ አታመልጥም፤ ዓይንህም የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ ዓይን ታያለች፥ እርሱም ከአንተ ጋር አፍ ለአፍ ይናገራል፥ ወደ ባቢሎንም ትገባለህ።

verses.en: Yet hear the word of YAHUAH, O Zedekiah king of Yehudah; Thus saith YAHUAH of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ አንተ እንዲህ ይላል። በሰይፍ አትሞትም፥ በሰላም ትሞታለህ እንጂ፤

verses.en: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከአንተ በፊት እንደ ነበሩ እንደ ዱሮ ነገሥታት እንደ አባቶችህ መቃጠል፥ እንዲሁ ያቃጥሉሃልና። ወየው! ጌታ ሆይ እያሉ ያለቅሱልሃል፤ እኔ ቃልን ተናግሬአለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Then Yirmeyahu the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Yehudah in Yerushalayim,

When the king of Babel's army fought against Yerushalayim, and against all the cities of Yehudah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Yehudah.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምንና የቀሩትን የይሁዳን ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ ከተመሸጉት ከይሁዳ ከተሞች የተረፉትን ለኪሶንና ዓዜቃን በወጋ ጊዜ፥ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ነገረው።

verses.en: This is the word that came unto Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Yerushalayim, to proclaim liberty unto them;
That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Ibri or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Yehudi his brother.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ ዕብራዊ የሆነውን ወንድ ባሪያውንና ዕብራዊት የሆነች ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ፥ አይሁዳዊ ወንድሙንም ማንም እንዳይገዛ፥ ስለ አርነታቸው አዋጅ እንዲነገር ንጉሡ ሴዴቅያስ በኢየሩሳሌም ከነበሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ካደረገ በኋላ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ ወንድ ባሪያውንና ሴት ባሪያውን አርነት እንዲያወጣ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ማንም እንዳይገዛቸው ወደ ቃል ኪዳኑ የገቡ አለቆች ሁሉና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሰሙ አርነትም አወጡአቸው።

verses.en: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ ተመልሰው አርነት ያወጡአቸውን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቻቸውን አስመለሱ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም አድርገው ገዙአቸው።

verses.en: Therefore the word of YAHUAH came to Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH, saying,
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Mitsrayim, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። አባቶቻችሁን ከባርነት ቤት ከግብጽ አገር ባወጣኋቸው ቀን ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዲህ ብዬ ቃል ኪዳን አደረግሁ።

verses.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Ibri, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
verses.am: ሰባት ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ የተሸጠላችሁን ስድስትም ዓመት የተገዛላችሁን ዕብራዊ ወንድማችሁን እያንዳንዳችሁ አርነት ታወጡታላችሁ፥ እያንዳንዱም ያወጣዋል፤ አባቶቻችሁ ግን አልሰሙኝም ጆሮአቸውንም አላዘነበሉም።

verses.en: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
verses.am: እናንተም ዛሬ ተመልሳችሁ ሰው ሁሉ ባልንጀራውን አርነት ለማውጣት አዋጅ በመንገር ለዓይኔ ደስ የሚያሰኝን ነገር አድርጋችሁ ነበር፥ በስሜም በሚጠራበት ቤት ውስጥ በፊቴ ቃል ኪዳን አድርጋችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ተመልሳችሁ ስሜን አስነቀፋችሁ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም በፈቃዳቸው እንዲሄዱ አርነት ያወጣችኋቸውን ወንድና ሴት ባሪያዎቻችሁን አስመለሳችሁ፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ባሪያዎችም እንዲሆኑላችሁ ገዛችኋቸው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith YAHUAH, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰው ሁሉ ለወንድሙና ለባልንጀራው የአርነት አዋጅ ለመንገር እኔን አልሰማችሁም፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ ለሰይፍና ለቸነፈር ለራብም የአርነት አዋጅ እናገርባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በምድርም መንግሥታት ሁሉ መካከል እንድትበተኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኔንም የተላለፉትን ሰዎች፥ እንቦሳውንም ቈርጠው በቍራጩ መካከል ባለፉ ጊዜ በፊቴ ያደረጉትን የቃል ኪዳንን ቃል ያልፈጸሙትን፥

verses.en: The princes of Yehudah, and the princes of Yerushalayim, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
verses.am: የይሁዳን አለቆችና የኢየሩሳሌምን አለቆች ጃንደረቦችን ካህናትንም በእንቦሳም ቍራጭ መካከል ያለፉትን የአገሩን ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.am: ለጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ነፍሳቸውንም ለሚሹአት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ ሬሳቸውም ለሰማይ ወፎችና ለምድር አራዊት መብል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Zedekiah king of Yehudah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babel's army, which are gone up from you.
verses.am: የይሁዳንም ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስንና አለቆቹን ለጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ነፍሳቸውንም ለሚሹአት እጅ ከእናንተም ለተመለሱት ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I will command, saith YAHUAH, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Yehudah a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አዝዛለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ወደዚህችም ከተማ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እርስዋንም ይወጋሉ ይይዙአትማል በእሳትም ያቃጥሉአታል፤ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ሰው የሌለበት ባድማ አደርጋቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: The word which came unto Yirmeyahu from YAHUAH in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yehudah, saying,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉስ በኢዮስያስ ልጅ በኢዮአቄም ዘመን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣ ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of YAHUAH, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
verses.am: ወደ ሬካባውያን ቤት ሄደህ ተናገራቸው፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ከጓዳዎቹ ወደ አንዲቱ አግባቸው የወይን ጠጅም አጠጣቸው።

verses.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Yirmeyahu, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
verses.am: የከባስንን ልጅ የኤርምያስን ልጅ ያእዛንያን ወንድሞቹንም ልጆቹንም ሁሉ የሬካባውያንን ወገን ሁሉ ወሰድኋቸው፤

verses.en: And I brought them into the house of YAHUAH, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of YAHUAH, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት በበረኛው በሰሎም ልጅ በመዕሤያ ጓዳ በላይ ባለው በአለቆች ጓዳ አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ጌዴልያ ልጅ ወደ ሐናን ልጆች ጓዳ አገባኋቸው።

verses.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
verses.am: በሬካባውያንም ልጆች ፊት የወይን ጠጅ የሞላባቸውን ማድጋዎችንና ጽዋዎችን አኑሬ። የወይኑን ጠጅ ጠጡ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን እንዲህ አሉ። የወይኑን ጠጅ አንጠጣም፥ አባታችን የሬካብ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ እንዲህ ብሎ አዝዞናልና። እናንተና ልጆቻችሁ ለዘላለም የወይን ጠጅ አትጠጡ።

verses.en: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.
verses.am: በምትኖሩባት ምድር ላይ ብዙ ዘመን እንድትኖሩ፥ በዕድሜአችሁ ሙሉ በድንኳን ውስጥ ተቀመጡ እንጂ ቤትን አትሥሩ፥ ዘርንም አትዝሩ፥ ወይንም አትትከሉ፥ አንዳችም አይሁንላችሁ።

verses.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
verses.am: እኛም የአባታችንን የሬካብ ልጅ የኢዮናዳብን ቃል ባዘዘን ነገር ሁሉ ታዝዘናል፤ እኛም ሚስቶቻችንም ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችንም ዕድሜአችንን ሙሉ የወይን ጠጅ አልጠጣንም፤

verses.en: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
verses.am: የምንቀመጥበትንም ቤት አልሠራንም፤ የወይን ቦታና እርሻ ዘርም የለንም፤

verses.en: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.am: በድንኳንም ውስጥ ተቀምጠናል፥ ታዝዘናል፥ አባታችንም ኢዮናዳብ ያዘዘንን ሁሉ አድርገናል።

verses.en: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Yerushalayim for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደዚህች ምድር በመጣ ጊዜ። ኑ ከከለዳውያን ሠራዊትና ከሶርያ ሠራዊት ፊት የተነሣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንሂድ አልን፤ እንዲሁም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጥን።

verses.en: Then came the word of YAHUAH unto Yirmeyahu, saying,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Go and tell the men of Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሂድና ለይሁዳ ሰዎችና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚቀመጡ ተናገር እንዲህም በላቸው። ቃሌን ትሰሙ ዘንድ ተግሣጽን አትቀበሉምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
verses.am: የሬካብ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ ልጆቹ የወይን ጠጅ እንዳይጠጡ ያዘዛቸው ቃል ተፈጸመ፤ ለአባታቸውም ትእዛዝ ታዝዘዋልና እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ አይጠጡም፤ እኔም በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ተናግሬአችኋለሁ፤ ተናገርሁ፥ ሆኖም አልሰማችሁኝም።

verses.en: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other elohim to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
verses.am: ደግሞም። እያንዳንዳችሁ ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፥ ሥራችሁንም አሳምሩ፥ ታመልኩአቸውም ዘንድ ሌሎችን አማልክት አትከተሉ፥ ለእናንተና ለአባቶቻችሁም በሰጠሁት ምድር ትቀመጣላችሁ እያልሁ በማለዳ ተነሥቼ ባሪያዎቼን ነቢያትን ሁሉ ልኬባችሁ ነበር፤ እናንተ ግን ጆሬአችሁን አላዘነበላችሁም እኔንም አልሰማችሁኝም።

verses.en: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
verses.am: የሬካብ ልጅ የኢዮናዳብ ልጆች አባታቸው ያዘዛቸውን ትእዛዝ ፈጽመዋልና፥ ይህ ሕዝብ ግን አልሰማኝምና፤

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Behold, I will bring upon Yehudah and upon all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በተናገርኋቸው ጊዜ አልሰሙምና፥ በጠራኋቸውም ጊዜ አልመለሱልኝምና የተናገርሁባቸውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ በይሁዳ ላይ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሚቀመጡ ሁሉ ላይ አመጣባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And Yirmeyahu said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
