verses.en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በሞዓብ ላይ የመጐብኘትን ዓመት አመጣበታለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ በፍርሃት የሸሸ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ ይወድቃል፥ ከgWdጓድም የወጣ በወጥመድ ይያዛል።

verses.en: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.am: የሸሹ ደክመው ከሐሴቦን ጥላ በታች ቆመዋል፤ እሳት ከሐሴቦን ነበልባልም ከሴዎን ወጥቶአል የሞዓብንም ማዕዘን የሤትንም ልጆች አናት በልቶአል።

verses.en: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
verses.am: ሞዓብ ሆይ፥ ወዮልህ! የካሞሽ ወገን ጠፍቶአል፤ ወንዶች ልጆችህ ተማርከዋልና፥ ሴቶች ልጆችህም ወደ ምርኮ ሄደዋልና።

verses.en: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith YAHUAH. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን የሞዓብን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር። የሞዓብ ፍርድ እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith YAHUAH; Hath Yisra'el no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
verses.am: ስለ አሞን ልጆች፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ለእስራኤል ልጆች የሉትምን? ወይስ ወራሽ የለውምን? ስለ ምን ሚልኮም ጋድን ወረሰ? ሕዝቡስ በከተሞቹ ላይ ስለ ምን ተቀመጠ?

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Yisra'el be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በአሞን ልጆች ከተማ በረባት ላይ የሰልፍ ውካታን የማሰማበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የፍርስራሽ ክምርም ትሆናለች፥ ሴቶች ልጆችዋም በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፥ እስራኤልም የወረሱትን ይወርሳል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
verses.am: ሐሴቦን ሆይ፥ ጋይ ፈርሳለችና አልቅሺላት እናንተም የረባት ሴቶች ልጆች ሆይ፥ ሚልኮም ካህናቱና አለቆቹም በአንድነት ይማረካሉና ጩኹ፥ ማቅም ታጠቁ፥ አልቅሱም፥ በቅጥሮችም መካከል ተርዋርዋጡ።

verses.en: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
verses.am: ማን ይመጣብኛል ብለሽ በመዝገብሽ የታመንሽ አንቺ ከዳተኛ ልጅ ሆይ፥ በሸለቆችሽ፥ ውኃ በሚያረካቸው ሸለቆችሽ፥ ስለ ምን ትመኪያለሽ?

verses.en: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith YAHUAH of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዙሪያሽ ካሉት ሁሉ ዘንድ ፍርሃትን አመጣብሻለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ እያንዳንዳችሁም በፊታችሁ ወዳለው ስፍራ ትሰደዳላችሁ፥ የሚሸሹትንም የሚሰበስብ የለም።

verses.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ የአሞንን ልጆች ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Concerning Edom, thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.am: ስለ ኤዶምያስ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በውኑ በቴማን ጥበብ የለምን? ከብልሃተኞችስ ምክር ጠፍቶአልን?

verses.en: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
verses.am: ጥበባቸውስ አልቆአልን? እናንተ በድዳን የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የዔሳውን ጥፋት፥ የምጐበኝበትን ጊዜ፥ አመጣበታለሁና ሽሹ፥ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ፥ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
verses.am: ወይን ለቃሚዎች ቢመጡብህ፥ ቃርሚያውን አይተውልህምን? ሌቦችስ በሌሊት ቢመጡ፥ የሚያጠፉት እስኪበቃቸው ድረስ አይደለምን?

verses.en: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ዔሳውን ዐራቈትሁት፥ የተሸሸጉትንም ስፍራዎች ገለጥሁ፥ ይሸሸግም ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ዘሩም ወንድሞቹም ጎረቤቶቹም ጠፍተዋል እርሱም የለም።

verses.en: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
verses.am: ድሀ አደጎችህን ተው፥ እኔም በሕይወት አኖራቸዋለሁ፤ መበለቶችህም በእኔ ይታመኑ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ጽዋውን ያልተገባቸው ሰዎች ጠጥተውታል፤ አንተም ሳትቀጣ ትቀራለህን? በእርግጥ ትጠጣለህ እንጂ ያለ ቅጣት አትቀርም።

verses.en: For I have sworn by myself, saith YAHUAH, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.am: ባሶራ መደነቂያና መሰደቢያ መረገሚያም እንድትሆን በራሴ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከተሞችዋም ሁሉ ለዘላለም ባድማ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: I have heard a rumour from YAHUAH, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወሬ ሰምቻለሁ በአሕዛብም መካከል። ተሰብሰቡ፥ በእርስዋም ላይ ኑ ለሰልፍም ተነሡ የሚል መልእክተኛ ተልኮአል።

verses.en: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ የተጠቃህ፥ በሰዎችም ዘንድ የተናቅህ አድርጌሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዓለት ንቃቃት ውስጥ የምትቀመጥ፥ የተራራውን ከፍታ የምትይዝ ሆይ፥ ድፍረትህና የልብህ ኵራት አታልለውሃል። ቤትህን ምንም እንደ ንስር ከፍ ብታደርግ፥ ከዚያ አወርድሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስም መደነቂያ ትሆናለች፥ የሚያልፍባትም ሁሉ ይደነቃል፥ ስለ መጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጭባታል።

verses.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith YAHUAH, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
verses.am: ሰዶምና ገሞራ በእነርሱም አጠገብ የነበሩት ከተሞች እንደ ተገለበጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ በዚያ ሰው አይቀመጥም የሰው ልጅም አይኖርባትም።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Therefore hear the counsel of YAHUAH, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በኤዶምያስ ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በቴማንም በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትንንሾች ይጐተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.am: ከመውደቃቸው ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ የጩኸታቸውም ድምፅ በኤርትራ ባሕር ተሰማ።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እንደ ንስር ወጥቶ ይበራል ክንፉንም በባሶራ ላይ ይዘረጋል፥ በዚያም ቀን የኤዶምያስ ኃያላን ልብ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ልብ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.am: ስለ ደማስቆ፤ ክፉ ወሬ ሰምተዋልና ሐማትና አርፋድ አፈሩ ቀለጡም፤ በባሕርም ላይ ኅዘን አለ፥ ታርፍም ዘንድ አትችልም።

verses.en: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.am: ደማስቆ ደከመች ትሸሽም ዘንድ ዘወር አለች እንቅጥቅጥም ያዛት፥ እንደ ወላድም ሴት ጣርና ምጥ ያዛት።

verses.en: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.am: የተመሰገነችው ከተማ፥ የደስታዬ ከተማ፥ ሳትለቀቅ እንዴት ቀረች?

verses.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith YAHUAH of hosts.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.am: በደማስቆም ቅጥር ላይ እሳት አነድዳለሁ የወልደ አዴርንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች።

verses.en: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel shall smite, thus saith YAHUAH; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ስለ መታ ስለ ቄዳርና ስለ አሶር መንግሥታት፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ተነሡ ወደ ቄዳርም ውጡ፥ የምሥራቅንም ልጆች አጥፉ።

verses.en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
verses.am: ድንኳናቸውንና መንጋቸውን ይወስዳሉ፤ መጋረጆቻቸውንና ዕቃቸውን ሁሉ ግመሎቻቸውንም ለራሳቸው ይወስዳሉ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋትን ጥሩባቸው።

verses.en: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith YAHUAH; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.am: እናንተ በአሶር የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ተማክሮባችኋልና፥ አሳብም አስቦባችኋልና ሽሹ ወደ ሩቅም ሂዱ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith YAHUAH, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
verses.am: ተነሡ፥ ዕርፊት ወዳለበት ተዘልሎም ወደ ተቀመጠው፥ ደጅና መወርወሪያ ወደሌለው ብቻውንም ወደ ተቀመጠው ሕዝብ ውጡ።

verses.en: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ግመሎቻቸው ይበዘበዛሉ የእንስሶቻቸውም ብዛት ይማረካል፤ ጠgWraቸውንም በዙሪያ የሚላጩትን ሰዎች ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከዳርቻቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋት አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
verses.am: አሶርም የቀበሮ መኖሪያና የዘላለም ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ በዚያም ሰው አይኖርም፥ የሰው ልጅም አይቀመጥባትም።

verses.en: The word of YAHUAH that came to Yirmeyahu the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yehudah, saying,
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ስለ ኤላም ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ዋና የኃይላቸው መሣሪያ የሆነውን የኤላምን ቀስት እሰብራለሁ።

verses.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.am: ከአራቱም ከሰማይ ማዕዘናት አራቱን ነፋሳት በኤላም ላይ አመጣለሁ፥ ወደ እነዚያም ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከኤላም የተሰደዱ ሰዎች የማይደርሱበት ሕዝብ አይገኝም።

verses.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith YAHUAH; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.am: በጠላቶቻቸውና ነፍሳቸውን በሚሹአት ፊት ኤላምን አስደነግጣለሁ፤ ክፉ ነገርን እርሱም ጽኑ ቍጣዬን አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ በኋላቸው ሰይፍ እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ዙፋኔንም በኤላም አኖራለሁ ከዚያም ንጉሡንና አለቆቹን አጠፋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን የኤላምን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: The word that YAHUAH spake against Babel and against the land of the Chaldeans by Yirmeyahu the prophet.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ከለዳውያን ምድር ስለ ባቢሎን በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babel is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል ተናገሩ አውሩም፥ ዓላማውንም አንሡ፤ አውሩ፥ አትደብቁ። ባቢሎን ተወሰደች፥ ቤል አፈረ፥ ሜሮዳክ ደነገጠ፤ ምስሎችዋ አፈሩ፥ ጣዖታትዋ ደነገጡ በሉ።

verses.en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.am: ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ወጥቶባታል ምድርዋንም ባድማ ያደርጋል፥ የሚቀመጥባትም አይገኝም፤ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ሸሽተው ሄደዋል።

verses.en: In those days, and in that time, saith YAHUAH, the children of Yisra'el shall come, they and the children of Yehudah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek YAHUAH their YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት በዚያም ጊዜ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ሆነው ይመጣሉ፥ እያለቀሱም መንገዳቸውን ይሄዳሉ፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to YAHUAH in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
verses.am: ፊታቸውንም ወደዚያ አቅንተው። ኑ፥ ከቶ በማይረሳ በዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተጠጉ ብለው ስለ ጽዮን መንገድ ይጠይቃሉ።

verses.en: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ የጠፉ በጎች ሆነዋል፤ እረኞቻቸው አሳቱአቸው፥ በተራሮችም ላይ የተቅበዘበዙ አደረጉአቸው፤ ከተራራ ወደ ኮረብታ አለፉ፥ በረታቸውንም ረሱ።

verses.en: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against YAHUAH, the habitation of justice, even YAHUAH, the hope of their fathers.
verses.am: ያገኙአቸው ሁሉ በሉአቸው፥ ጠላቶቻቸውም። በጽድቅ ማደሪያ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ፥ በአባቶቻቸው ተስፋ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ስለ ሠሩ እኛ አልበደልንም አሉ።

verses.en: Remove out of the midst of Babel, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን መካከል ሽሹ፥ ከከለዳውያንም ድር ውጡ፥ በመንጎችም ፊት እንደ አውራ ፍየሎች ሁኑ።

verses.en: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babel an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን ምድር የታላላቅ አሕዛብን ጉባኤ አስነሣለሁ በባቢሎንም ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ በእርስዋም ላይ ይሰለፋሉ፥ ከዚያም ትወሰዳለች፤ ፍላጾቻቸውም ባዶውን እንደማይመለስ እንደ ብልህ ጀግና ፍላጻ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: የከላውዴዎንም ምድር ትበዘበዛለች፥ የሚበዘብዙአትም ሁሉ ይጠግባሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
verses.am: ርስቴን የምትበዘብዙ እናንተ ሆይ፥ ደስ ብሎአችኋልና፥ ሐሤትንም አድርጋችኋልና፥ በመስክ ላይም እንዳለች ጊደር ሆናችሁ ተቀናጥታችኋልና፥ እንደ ብርቱዎችም ፈረሶች አሽካክታችኋልና፥

verses.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.am: እናታችሁ እጅግ ታፍራለች፥ የወለደቻችሁም ትጐሰቍላለች፤ እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል ኋለኛይቱ ትሆናለች፤ ምድረ በዳና ደረቅ ምድር በረሀም ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Because of the wrath of YAHUAH it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babel shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ የተነሣ ባድማ ትሆናለች እንጂ ሰው አይቀመጥባትም፤ በባቢሎንም በኩል የሚያልፍ ሁሉ ይደነቃል በመጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጫል።

verses.en: Put yourselves in array against Babel round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተ ቀስትን የምትገትሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በባቢሎን ላይ በዙሪያዋ ተሰለፉ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርታለችና ወርውሩባት ፍላጾችንም አትንፈጉ።

verses.en: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of YAHUAH: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ነውና በዙሪያዋ ጩኹባት፤ እጅዋን ሰጠች፤ ግንቦችዋ ወደቁ ቅጥሮችዋም ፈረሱ፤ እርስዋን ተበቀሉ እንደ ሠራችውም ሥሩባት።

verses.en: Cut off the sower from Babel, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land. sickle; or, scythe
verses.am: ዘሪውንና በመከር ጊዜ ማጭድ የሚይዘውን ከባቢሎን አጥፉ፤ ከሚያስጨንቅ ሰይፍ ፊት እያንዳንዱ ወደ ወገኑ ይመለሳል እያንዳንዱም ወደ አገሩ ይሸሻል።

verses.en: Yisra'el is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel hath broken his bones.
verses.am: እስራኤል የባዘነ በግ ነው፤ አንበሶች አሳደዱት፤ መጀመሪያ የአሦር ንጉሥ በላው፥ በመጨረሻም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር አጥንቱን ቈረጠመው።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; Behold, I will punish the king of Babel and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሦርን ንጉሥ እንደ ቀጣሁ እንዲሁ፥ እነሆ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥና ምድሩን እቀጣለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring Yisra'el again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.am: እስራኤልንም ወደ ማሰማርያው እመልሳለሁ፥ በቀርሜሎስና በባሳንም ላይ ይሰማራል፥ ሰውነቱም በኤፍሬም ተራራና በገለዓድ ላይ ትጠግባለች።

verses.en: In those days, and in that time, saith YAHUAH, the iniquity of Yisra'el shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Yehudah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
verses.am: እነዚህን ያስቀረኋቸውን ይቅር እላቸዋለሁና በዚያን ወራት በዚያም ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል በደል የይሁዳም ኃጢአት ይፈለጋል ምንም አይገኝም።

verses.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith YAHUAH, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
verses.am: በምራታይም ምድር ላይ በፋቁድም በሚኖሩት ላይ ውጣ፤ ግደላቸው ፈጽመህም አጥፋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዳዘዝሁህም ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
verses.am: የሰልፍና የታላቅ ጥፋት ውካታ በምድር ላይ አለ።

verses.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babel become a desolation among the nations!
verses.am: የምድር ሁሉ መዶሻ እንዴት ደቀቀ እንዴትስ ተሰበረ! ባቢሎንስ በአሕዛብ መካከል እንዴት ባድማ ሆነች!

verses.en: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babel, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against YAHUAH.
verses.am: ባቢሎን ሆይ፥ አጥምጄብሻለሁ አንቺም ሳታውቂ ተይዘሻል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስለ ተዋጋሽ ተገኝተሻል ተይዘሽማል።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of YAHUAH of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በከለዳውያን ምድር ይሠራ ዘንድ ሥራ አለውና እግዚአብሔር ዕቃ ቤቱን ከፍቶ የቍጣውን ዕቃ ጦር አውጥቶአል።

verses.en: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
verses.am: ከየበኩሉ በእርስዋ ላይ ውጡ፥ ጎተራዎችዋንም ክፈቱ፤ እንደ ክምርም አድርጓት ፈጽማችሁም አጥፉአት፥ አንዳችም አታስቀሩላት።

verses.en: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
verses.am: ወይፈኖችዋን ሁሉ እረዱ፥ ወደ መታረድም ይውረዱ፤ ቀናቸው፥ የመጐብኘታቸው ጊዜ፥ ደርሶአልና ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babel, to declare in Zion the vengeance of YAHUAH our YAHUAH, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.am: የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን በቀል የመቅደሱንም በቀል በጽዮን ይነግሩ ዘንድ ሸሽተው ከባቢሎን አገር ያመለጡት ሰዎች ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Call together the archers against Babel: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against YAHUAH, against the Holy One of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ቀስትን የሚገትሩትን ቀስተኞችን ሁሉ በባቢሎን ላይ ጥሩአቸው፤ በዙሪያዋ ስፈሩባት አንድም አያምልጥ፤ በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርታለችና እንደ ሥራዋ መጠን መልሱላት፥ እንዳደረገችም ሁሉ አድርጉባት።

verses.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞችዋ ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith YAHUAH of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኛው ሆይ፥ የመጐብኘትህ ጊዜ፥ ቀንህ ደርሶአልና እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኛው ተሰናክሎ ይወድቃል የሚያነሣውም የለም፤ በከተሞቹም ውስጥ እሳት አነድዳለሁ፥ በዙሪያውም ያለውን ሁሉ ትበላለች።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; The children of Yisra'el and the children of Yehudah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ተገፍተዋል፥ የማረኳቸውም ሁሉ በኃይል ይይዙአቸዋል፥ ይለቅቁአቸውም ዘንድ እንቢ ብለዋል።

verses.en: Their Redeemer is strong; YAHUAH of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babel.
verses.am: ተቤዢአቸው ብርቱ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ምድርንም ያሳርፍ ዘንድ በባቢሎንም የሚኖሩትን ያውክ ዘንድ ሙግታቸውን ፈጽም ይምዋገታል።

verses.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith YAHUAH, and upon the inhabitants of Babel, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
verses.am: ሰይፍ በከለዳውያንና በባቢሎን በሚኖሩ ላይ፥ በአለቆችዋና በጥበበኞችዋ ላይ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
verses.am: ሰይፍ በሚጓደዱት ላይ አለ ሰነፎችም ይሆናሉ፥ ሰይፍም በኃያላኖችዋ ላይ አለ እነርሱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
verses.am: ሰይፍ በፈረሶቻቸውና በሰረገሎቻቸው ላይ በመካከልዋም ባሉት በልዩ በልዩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ላይ አለ፥ እነርሱም እንደ ሴቶች ይሆናሉ፤ ሰይፍም በመዝገብዋ ላይ አለ ለብዝበዛም ይሆናል።

verses.en: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
verses.am: እርስዋ የተቀረጹ ምስሎች ምድር ናት፥ እነርሱም በጣዖታት ይመካሉና ድርቅ በውኆችዋ ላይ ይሆናል እነርሱም ይደርቃሉ።

verses.en: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ከተኵላዎች ጋር ይቀመጡባታል፥ ሰጐኖችም ይቀመጡባታል፤ ሰውም ከዚያ ወዲያ ለዘላለም አይቀመጥባትም፥ እስከ ልጅ ልጅም ድረስ የሚኖርባት የለም።

verses.en: As YAHUAH overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith YAHUAH; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.am: ሰዶምንና ገሞራን በአጠገባቸውም የነበሩትን ከተምች እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጣቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ ሰው በዚያ አይቀመጥም የሰውም ልጅ አይኖርባትም።

verses.en: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ይመጣል ታላቅ ሕዝብና ብዙ ነገሥታትም ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣሉ።

verses.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babel.
verses.am: ቀስትንና ጦርን ይይዛሉ፤ ጨካኞች ናቸው ምሕረትም አያደርጉም፤ ድምፃቸው እንደ ባሕር ይተምማል በፈረሶችም ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ የባቢሎን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ሰው እያንዳንዳቸው በአንቺ ላይ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: The king of Babel hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወሬአቸውን ሰምቶአል፥ እጁም ደክማለች፥ ጭንቀትም ይዞታል፥ ምጥ ወላድ ሴትን እንደሚይዛት ጭንቀት ይዞታል።

verses.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of YAHUAH, that he hath taken against Babel; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በከለዳውያንም ምድር ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትናንሾች ይጎተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።

verses.en: At the noise of the taking of Babel the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን መያዝ ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ ጩኸትም በአሕዛብ መካከል ዘንድ ተሰማ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, I will raise up against Babel, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በባቢሎን ላይና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ አጥፊውን ነፋስ አስነሣለሁ።

verses.en: And will send unto Babel fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.am: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚያዘሩትን ሰዎች እሰድዳለሁ እነርሱም ያዘሩአታል፥ ምድርዋንም ባዶ ያደርጋሉ፤ በመከራም ቀን በዙሪያዋ ይከብቡአታል።

verses.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
verses.am: በወርዋሪው ላይ በጥሩርም በሚነሣው ላይ ቀስተኛው ቀስቱን ይገትር፤ ለጐበዛዝትዋ አትዘኑ ሠራዊትዋንም ሁሉ አጥፉ።

verses.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
verses.am: በከለዳውያንም ምድር ተገድለው፥ በሜዳዋም ላይ ተወግተው ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: For Yisra'el hath not been forsaken, nor Yehudah of his YAHUAH, of YAHUAH of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ምድራቸው በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በተሠራው በደል ምንም እንኳ የተሞላች ብትሆን፥ እስራኤልም ሆነ ይሁዳ በአምላኩ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አልተጣለም።

verses.en: Flee out of the midst of Babel, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of YAHUAH's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን ውስጥ ሽሹ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ነፍሳችሁን አድኑ፤ በበደልዋ አትጥፉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ጊዜ ነውና፥ እርሱም ብድራትዋን ይከፍላታልና።

verses.en: Babel hath been a golden cup in YAHUAH's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
verses.am: ባቢሎን በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ውስጥ ምድርን ሁሉ ያሰከረች የወርቅ ጽዋ ነበረች፥ አሕዛብም ከጠጅዋ ጠጥተዋል፤ ስለዚህ አሕዛብ አብደዋል።

verses.en: Babel is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
verses.am: ባቢሎን በድንገት ወድቃ ጠፍታለች፤ አልቅሱላት፥ ትፈወስም እንደ ሆነ ለKWsልዋ መድኃኒት ውሰዱላት።

verses.en: We would have healed Babel, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
verses.am: ባቢሎንን ፈወስናት፥ እርስዋ ግን አልተፈወሰችም፤ ፍርድዋ እስከ ሰማይ ደርሶአልና፥ እስከ ደመናም ድረስ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ትታችኋት እያንዳንዳችን ወደ አገራችን እንሂድ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችንን አውጥቶአል፤ ኑ፥ በጽዮን የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ እንናገር።

verses.en: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: YAHUAH hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babel, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of YAHUAH, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.am: ፍላጾችን ሳሉ ጋሻዎችንም አዘጋጁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ያጠፋት ዘንድ አሳቡ በባቢሎን ላይ ነውና የሜዶንን ነገሥታት መንፈስ አስነሥቶአል፤ የእግዚብሔር በቀል የመቅደሱ በቀል ነውና።

verses.en: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babel, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for YAHUAH hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babel.
verses.am: በባቢሎን ቅጥር ዓላማውን አንሡበት፥ ጥበቃን አጽኑ፥ ተመልካቾችን አቁሙ፥ ድብቅ ጦር አዘጋጁ። እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን በሚኖሩት ላይ የተናገረውን አስቦአልና፥ አድርጎአልምና።

verses.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
verses.am: አንቺ በብዙ ውኃ አጠገብ የተቀመጥሽ፥ በመዝገብም የበለጠግሽ ሆይ፥ እንደ ስስትሽ መጠን ፍጻሜሽ ደርሶአል።

verses.en: YAHUAH of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ሲል በራሱ ምሎአል። በእውነት ሰዎችን እንደ አንበጣ እሞላብሻለሁ፥ እነርሱም ጩኸት ያነሡብሻል።

verses.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
verses.am: ምድርን በኃይሉ የፈጠረ፥ ዓለሙን በጥበቡ የመሠረተ፥ ሰማያትንም በማስተዋሉ የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.am: ድምጹን ባሰማ ጊዜ ውኆች በሰማይ ይታወካሉ፥ ከምድርም ዳር ደመናትን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ ለዝናብም መብረቅን ያደርጋል፥ ነፍስንም ከቤተ መዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ እውቀት አጥቶ ሰንፎአል፥ አንጥረኛም ሁሉ ከቀረጸው ምስል የተነሣ አፍሮአል፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስሉ ውሸት ነውና፥ እስትንፋስም የላቸውምና።

verses.en: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.am: እነርሱም ምናምንቴና የቀልድ ሥራ ናቸው፤ በተጐበኙ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The portion of Ya'aqob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Yisra'el is the rod of his inheritance: YAHUAH of hosts is his name.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ እድል ፈንታ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፥ እርሱ የሁሉ ፈጣሪ ነውና፤ እስራኤልም የርስቱ ነገድ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.am: አንቺ መዶሻዬና የጦር መሣሪያዬ ነሽ፤ በአንቺ አሕዛብን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም መንግሥታትን አጠፋለሁ፤

verses.en: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
verses.am: በአንቺ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን እሰባብራለሁ፤

verses.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
verses.am: በአንቺም ሰረገላውንና በላዩ የሚቀመጠውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ወንድንና ሴትን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ሽማግሌውንና ብላቴናውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ጐልማሳውንና ቆንጆይቱን እሰባብራለሁ፤

verses.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
verses.am: በአንቺም እረኛውንና መንጋውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አራሹንና ጥማጁን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አለቆችንና ሹማምቶችን አሰባብራለሁ።

verses.en: And I will render unto Babel and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በጽዮን በዓይናችሁ ፊት ስለሠሩት ክፋታቸው ሁሉ በባቢሎንና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ፍዳቸውን እከፍላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith YAHUAH, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
verses.am: አንተ ምድርን ሁሉ የምታጠፋ አጥፊ ተራራ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እጄንም እዘረጋብሃለሁ፥ ከድንጋዮችም ላይ አንከባልልሃለሁ፥ የተቃጠለም ተራራ አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከአንተም ለማዕዘንና ለመሠረት የሚሆን ድንጋይ አይወስዱም፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ ትሆናለህ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ዓላማን አንሡ በአሕዛብም መካከል መለከት ንፉ፥ አሕዛብንም አዘጋጁባት፤ የአራራትንና የሚኒን የአስከናዝንም መንግሥታት ሰብስቡባት አለቃንም በላይዋ አቁሙ፤ እንደ ጠgWraም ኩብኩባ ፈረሶችን በላይዋ አውጡ።

verses.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
verses.am: አሕዛብን የሚዶንንም ነገሥታት አለቆችንም ሹማምቶችንም ሁሉ የግዛታቸውንም ምድር ሁሉ አዘጋጁባት።

verses.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of YAHUAH shall be performed against Babel, to make the land of Babel a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.am: ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት የባቢሎንን ምድር ባድማ ያደርጋት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አሳብ በባቢሎን ላይ ጸንቶአልና ምድር ተናወጣለች ታመመችም።

verses.en: The mighty men of Babel have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ኃያላን መዋጋትን ትተዋል በአምባዎቻቸውም ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል፤ ኃይላቸውም ጠፍቶአል እንደ ሴቶችም ሆነዋል፤ ማደሪያዎችዋም ነድደዋል መወርወሪያዎችዋም ተሰብረዋል።

verses.en: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babel that his city is taken at one end,
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አውድማ እንደ ተረገጠ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የባቢሎን ልጅ ናት፤ ጥቂት ቈይታ የመከር ጊዜ ይደርስባታል።

verses.en: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አውድማ እንደ ተረገጠ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የባቢሎን ልጅ ናት፤ ጥቂት ቈይታ የመከር ጊዜ ይደርስባታል።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el; The daughter of Babel is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
verses.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በላኝ፥ ከፋፈለኝም፥ እንደ ባዶ ዕቃም አደረገኝ፥ እንደ ዘንዶም ዋጠኝ፥ ከሚጣፍጠውም ምግቤ ሆዱን ሞላ፥ እኔንም ጣለኝ።

verses.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babel hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
verses.am: በጽዮን የምትቀመጥ። በእኔና በሥጋዬ የተደረገ ግፍ በባቢሎን ላይ ይሁን ትላለች፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም። ደሜ በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ ይሁን ትላለች።

verses.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babel, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Yerushalayim say.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እምዋገትልሻለሁ በቀልሽንም እበቀልልሻለሁ፤ ባሕርዋንም ድርቅ አደርገዋለሁ ምንጭዋንም አደርቀዋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
verses.am: ባቢሎንም የድንጋይ KWlልና የቀበሮ ማደሪያ መደነቂያም ማፍዋጫም ትሆናለች፥ የሚቀመጥባትም ሰው አይገኝም።

verses.en: And Babel shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
verses.am: በአንድነትም እንደ አንበሶች ያገሣሉ፥ እንደ አንበሳም ደቦሎች ያጕረመርማሉ።

verses.en: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.
verses.am: በሞቃቸው ጊዜ ደስ እንዲላቸው ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው እንዳይነቁ የመጠጥ ግብዣ አደርግላቸዋለሁ አሰክራቸውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንደ ጠቦቶችና እንደ አውራ በጎች እንደ አውራ ፍየሎችም ወደ መታረድ አወርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
verses.am: ሼሻክ እንዴት ተያዘች! የምድርም ሁሉ ምስጋና እንዴት ተወሰደች! ባቢሎንም በአሕዛብ መካከል መደነቂያ እንዴት ሆነች!

verses.en: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babel become an astonishment among the nations!
verses.am: ባሕር በባቢሎን ላይ ወጣ በሞገዱም ብዛት ተከደነች።

verses.en: The sea is come up upon Babel: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
verses.am: ከተሞችዋ ባድማና ደረቅ ምድር ምድረ በዳም፥ ሰውም የማይቀመጥበት የሰውም ልጅ የማያልፍበት ምድር ሆኑ።

verses.en: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
verses.am: በባቢሎንም ውስጥ ቤልን እቀጣለሁ የዋጠውንም ከአፉ አስተፋዋለሁ፤ አሕዛብም ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ እርሱ አይሰበሰቡም፥ የባቢሎንም ቅጥር ይወድቃል።

verses.en: And I will punish Bel in Babel, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babel shall fall.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ከመካከልዋ ውጡ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ ራሳችሁን አድኑ።

verses.en: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of YAHUAH.
verses.am: በምድርም ከሚሰማ ወሬ የተነሣ አትፍሩ ልባችሁም የዛለ አይሁን፤ በአንድ ዓመት ወሬ ይመጣል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በሌላው ዓመት ወሬ፥ በምድርም ላይ ግፍ ይመጣል፥ አለቃም በአለቃ ላይ ይነሣል።

verses.en: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን የባቢሎን ምስሎች የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ምድርዋም ሁሉ ታፍራለች፤ ተወግተውም የሞቱት ሁሉ በመካከልዋ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babel: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.am: አጥፊዎች ከሰሜን ይመጡባታልና ሰማይና ምድር በእነርሱም ያለው ሁሉ ስለ ባቢሎን እልል ይላሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babel: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ባቢሎንም ከእስራኤል ተወግተው የሞቱት እንዲወድቁ እንዳደረገች፥ እንዲሁ በባቢሎን ከምድሩ ሁሉ ተወግተው የሞቱት ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: As Babel hath caused the slain of Yisra'el to fall, so at Babel shall fall the slain of all the earth.
verses.am: ከሰይፍ ያመለጣችሁ ሆይ፥ ሂዱ፥ አትቁሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርን ከሩቅ አስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በልባችሁ አስቡ።

verses.en: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember YAHUAH afar off, and let Yerushalayim come into your mind.
verses.am: ስድብን ስለ ሰማን አፍረናል፤ ባዕዳን ሰዎችም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ገብተዋልና ነውር ፊታችንን ከድኖታል።

verses.en: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of YAHUAH's house.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችዋ የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር በምድርዋም ላይ ሁሉ የተወጉት ያንቋርራሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith YAHUAH, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.am: ባቢሎን ምንም ወደ ሰማይ ብትወጣ፥ የኃይልዋንም ከፍታ ብታጸና፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ አጥፊዎች ይመጡባታል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Though Babel should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን ጩኸት፥ ከከለዳውያንም ምድር የታላቅ ጥፋት ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babel, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ባቢሎንን አጥፍቶአታልና፥ ከእርስዋም ታላቁን ድምፅ ዝም አሰኝቶአልና፤ ሞገዳቸውም እንደ ብዙ ውኆች ይተምማል፥ የድምፃቸውም ጩኸት ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Because YAHUAH hath spoiled Babel, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
verses.am: አጥፊው በባቢሎን ላይ መጥቶባታልና፥ ኃያላኖችዋ ተያዙ፥ ቀስታቸውም ተሰባበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ፍዳን የሚከፍል አምላክ ነውና፥ ፍዳንም በእርግጥ ይከፍላል።

verses.en: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babel, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for YAHUAH of recompences shall surely requite.
verses.am: መሳፍንቶችዋንና ጥበበኞችዋንም፥ አለቆችዋንና ሹማምቶችዋን ኃያላኖችዋንም አሰክራለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው አይነቁም፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተባለው ንጉሥ።

verses.en: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is YAHUAH of hosts.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰፊው የባቢሎን ቅጥር ፈጽሞ ይፈርሳል ረጃጅሞችም በሮችዋ በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፤ የወገኖችም ድካም ከንቱ ትሆናለች፥ የአሕዛብም ሥራ ለእሳት ትሆናለች፤ እነርሱም ይደክማሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH of hosts; The broad walls of Babel shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
verses.am: የመሕሤያ ልጅ የኔርያ ልጅ ሠራያ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን በሄደ ጊዜ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ያዘዘው ቃል ይህ ነው። ሠራያም የቤት አዛዥ ነበረ።

verses.en: The word which Yirmeyahu the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Yehudah into Babel in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
verses.am: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚመጣውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ፥ ስለ ባቢሎን የተጻፈውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ኤርምያስ በመጽሐፍ ላይ ጻፈው።

verses.en: So Yirmeyahu wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babel, even all these words that are written against Babel.
verses.am: ኤርምያስም ሠራያን እንዲህ አለው። ወደ ባቢሎን በገባህ ጊዜ እይ ይህንም ቃል ሁሉ አንብብና።

verses.en: And Yirmeyahu said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babel, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ እንድትሆን ታጠፋት ዘንድ በዚህች ስፍራ ላይ ተናግረሃል በል።

verses.en: Then shalt thou say, O YAHUAH, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.am: ይህንም መጽሐፍ ማንበብ ከፈጸምህ በኋላ፥ ድንጋይን እሰርበት በኤፍራጥስም ውስጥ ጣለው፤

verses.en: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
verses.am: አንተም። እኔ ከማመጣባት ክፉ ነገር የተነሣ እንዲሁ ባቢሎን ትሰጥማለች አትነሣምም በል። የኤርምያስ ቃል እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።

verses.en: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babel sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Yirmeyahu.
Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Yirmeyahu of Libnah.
verses.am: ሴዴቅያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም አሚጣል የተባለች የሊብና ሰው የኤርምያስ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of YAHUAH, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.am: ኢዮአቄምም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.en: For through the anger of YAHUAH it came to pass in Yerushalayim and Yehudah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babel.
verses.am: ከፊቱም አውጥቶ እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ላይ ሆኖአልና፤ ሴዴቅያስም በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel came, he and all his army, against Yerushalayim, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
verses.am: ሴዴቅያስም በነገሠ በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ መጥተው ከበቡአት በዙሪያዋም ዕርድ አደረገ።

verses.en: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.am: ከተማይቱም እስከ ንጉሡ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ድረስ ተከብባ ነበር።

verses.en: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.am: በአራተኛውም ወር በዘጠነኛው ቀን በከተማይቱ ራብ ጸንቶ ነበር፥ ለአገሩም ሰዎች እንጀራ ታጣ።

verses.en: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
verses.am: ከተማይቱም ተሰበረች፥ ሰልፈኞችም ሁሉ ሸሹ፥ በሁለቱም ቅጥር መካከል ባለው በር ወደ ንጉሡ አትክልት በሚወስደው መንገድ በሌሊት ከከተማይቱ ወጡ። ከለዳውያንም በከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ነበሩ፤ በዓረባም መንገድ ሄዱ።

verses.en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.am: የከለዳውያንም ሠራዊት ንጉሡን ተከታተሉት፥ በኢያሪኮም ሜዳ ሴዴቅያስን ያዙ፤ ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተበትነው ነበር።

verses.en: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babel to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
verses.am: ንጉሡንም ይዘው የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለባት በሐማት ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሪብላ አመጡት፤ እርሱም ፍርድን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And the king of Babel slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Yehudah in Riblah.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ የሴዴቅያስን ልጆች በፊቱ ገደላቸው፥ የይሁዳንም አለቆች ሁሉ ደግሞ በሪብላ ገደላቸው።

verses.en: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babel bound him in chains, and carried him to Babel, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.am: የሴዴቅያስንም ዓይኖች አወጣ፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሰንሰለት አሰረው ወደ ባቢሎንም ወሰደው፥ እስኪሞትም ድረስ በግዞት ቤት አኖረው።

verses.en: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babel, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babel, into Yerushalayim,
verses.am: በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በአሥራ ዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረናው ከን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ፊት የቆመው የዘበኞቹ አለካ ናቡዘረዳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።

verses.en: And burned the house of YAHUAH, and the king's house; and all the houses of Yerushalayim, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት አቃጠለ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ ታላላቆችን ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Yerushalayim round about.
verses.am: ከዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጋር የነበረው የከለዳውያን ሠራዊት ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር ሁሉ ዙሪያዋን አፈረሱ።

verses.en: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babel, and the rest of the multitude.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን የሕዝቡን ድኆች፥ በከተማም ውስጥ የቀረውን ሕዝብ፥ ሸሽተውም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ የተጠጉትን፥ የሕዝቡንም ቅሬታ አፈለሰ።

verses.en: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአገሩ ድኆች ወይን ተካዮችና አራሾች እንዲሆኑ አስቀረ።

verses.en: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of YAHUAH, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of YAHUAH, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babel.
verses.am: ከለዳውያንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበሩትን የናስ ዓምዶች በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የነበሩትን መቀመጫዎችና የናሱን ኵሬ ሰባበሩ፥ ናሱንም ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱ።

verses.en: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.am: ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎችንም መኰስተሪያዎችንና ድስቶችን ጭልፋዎችንም የሚያገለግሉበትንም የናስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጽዋዎቹንና ማንደጃዎቹን ድስቶቹንና ምንቸቶችን መቅረዞችንና ጭልፋዎቹን መንቀሎችንም፥ የወርቁን ዕቃ በወርቅ፥ የብሩንም ዕቃ በብር አድርጎ፥ ወሰደ።

verses.en: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Shelomoh had made in the house of YAHUAH: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያሠራቸውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች፥ አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ ከመቀመጫዎቹም በታች የነበሩትን አሥራ ሁለቱን የናስ በሬዎች ወሰደ፤ ለእነዚህ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ናስ ሚዛን አልነበረም።

verses.en: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
verses.am: ዓምዶቹም፥ የአንዱ ዓምድ ቁመት አሥራ ስምንት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የዙሪያውም መጠን አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውፍረቱም አራት ጣት ያህል ነበረ፥ ባዶም ነበረ።

verses.en: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
verses.am: የናሱም ጕልላት በላዩ ነበረ፤ የአንዱም ጉልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ በጕልላቱም ላይ በዙሪያው ሁሉ ከናስ የተሠሩ መረበብና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት፤ በሁለተኛውም ዓምድ ደግሞ እንደዚህ ያለ ነገርና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት።

verses.en: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
verses.am: በስተ ውጭም ዘጠና ስድስት ሮማኖች ነበሩ። በመረበቡም ዙሪያ የነበሩ ሮማኖች ሁሉ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Tsephanyah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ታላቁን ካህን ሠራያን ሁለተኛውንም ካህን ሶፎንያስን ሦስቱንም በረኞች ወሰደ፤

verses.en: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
verses.am: ከከተማይቱም በሰልፈኞች ላይ ተሾመው ከነበሩት አንዱን ጀንደረባ፥ በከተማይቱም ከሚገኙት በንጉሡ ፊት ከሚቆሙት ሰባቱን ሰዎች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ የሚያሰልፈውን የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ጸሐፊ፥ በከተማይቱም ከተገኙት ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ስድሳ ሰዎች ወሰደ።

verses.en: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babel to Riblah.
verses.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወስዶ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለበት ወደ ሪብላ አመጣቸው።

verses.en: And the king of Babel smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Yehudah was carried away captive out of his own land.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ መታቸው፥ በሐማትም ምድር ባለችው በሪብላ ገደላቸው። እንዲሁ ይሁዳ ከአገሩ ተማረከ።

verses.en: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Yehudim and three and twenty:
verses.am: ናቡከደነፆር የማረከው ሕዝብ ይህ ነው፤ በሰባተኛው ዓመት ሦስት ሺህ ሀያ ሦስት አይሁድ፤

verses.en: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Yerushalayim eight hundred thirty and two persons:
verses.am: ናቡከደነፆርም በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ስምንት መቶ ሠላሳ ሁለት ነፍስ ከኢየሩሳሌም ማርኮአል፤

verses.en: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Yehudim seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
verses.am: በናቡከደነፆር በሀያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአይሁድ ሰባት መቶ አርባ አምስት ነፍስ ማርኮአል፤ ሰዎች ሁሉ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babel in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah, and brought him forth out of prison,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን በተማረከ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያ አምስተኛው ቀን፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዮርማሮዴክ በነገሠ በአንደኛው ዓመት የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የዮአኪንን ራስ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ ከወህኒም አወጣው፤

verses.en: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babel,
verses.am: በመልካምም ተናገረው፥ ዙፋኑንም ከእርሱ ጋር በባቢሎን ከነበሩት ነገሥታት ዙፋን በላይ አደረገለት።

verses.en: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
verses.am: በወህኒም ውስጥ ለብሶት የነበረውን ልብስ ለወጠለት፥ ዮአኪንም በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ በፊቴ ሁልጊዜ እንጀራ ይበላ ነበር።

verses.en: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babel, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
verses.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ እስኪሞት ድረስ የዘወትር ቀለብ ዕለት ዕለት ይሰጠው ነበር።
